Lead Product Manager

Team

Product

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

At Grab Financial Service, we empower the people of Southeast Asia, from consumers and drivers to everyday entrepreneurs, by enabling financial inclusion for the underserved. The team is building innovative solutions by enabling commerce through banking services (invest, savings), payment services (checkout, payments platform, grab pay products, rewards), empowering through Lending(driver & merchants), empowering through agents (Kios) & protecting users through Insurance(scenario insurance). All product managers in Grab Financial Service are regional product managers across Grab's Southeast Asian markets.

Get to Know the Role

You will manage the product strategy, roadmap & execution of agent network & wallet core. You will be reporting to Senior Product Management Leader and based onsite in Grab Jakarta office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Define and own the vision, strategy, goals, and roadmap

Dive deep into our data to identify the biggest opportunities to optimize our systems to benefit Users and Grab.

Own project delivery, feature development, and experimentation end-to-end, including creating detailed product & business requirements, driving cross-functional execution, sharing insights and learnings across the org, and ensuring stakeholder visibility

Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, and data science to define an product strategy, develop and maintain a prioritized product backlog, and execute on delivering great experiences for users. Collaborate with Product Marketing, other Product teams, and regional/country teams on go-to-market strategies and execution.

8+ years experience in product management at a tech software company, with demonstrable success in formulating product strategy & launching new products/features with clear impact

Bachelors in computer science, software engineering, information technology, business, finance, economics, or related fields.

Experience working with distributed teams.

Empathy for users and a drive to discover and resolve their pain points.

title: AVP-AI/ML Solution
raw_description:
Job Title:  AVP - AI/ML Solution

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Act as the primary interface between business leaders and the technical team, translating complex business needs into robust technical requirements and high-impact AI roadmaps
  • Lead the communication strategy to explain complex technical AI/ML concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders across the organization.
  • Ensure all deployed models and data pipelines maintain high accuracy, stability, and measurable business impact through rigorous experimentation frameworks
  • Oversee and guide the design, development, and production deployment of scalable AI/ML systems
  • Define model objectives and success metrics, ensuring all AI/ML initiatives directly drive CX uplift and revenue growth
  • Partner deeply with Network, Commercial, and Vendor Management teams to co-create AI-native solutions and champion data-driven decision-making across the organization

 

Requirements

 

Technical Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics or related field.
  • Minimum of 7–10+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning and  AI Solutions, with at least 2–3 years in a leadership, managerial, or principal consulting role (preferably within the telecommunications or consulting sector)
  • Demonstrated success in leading cross-functional teams to design, scale, and deliver complex data pipelines, ingestion architectures, and productionized AI products.
  • Deep, hands-on architectural familiarity with Multi-Agent systems and orchestration frameworks
  • Expert-level command of Python and deep experience across production frameworks like XGBoost, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
  • Expert knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Data/AI products (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run) and big data processing (Spark, Dataproc)
  • Strong familiarity with Telco data structures, network performance metrics and open industry frameworks (e.g., TM Forum Open Digital Architecture)
  • Robust understanding of production MLOps lifecycles (CI/CD) and enterprise orchestration
  • Professional certifications such as Google Certified Professional Machine Learning Engineer or equivalent Cloud Architect/AI credentials are highly regarded

 

Soft Skills :

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and team management skills to effectively direct a technical team and collaborate across a matrixed organization
  • Proven ability to lead and drive initiatives independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Exceptional analytical, conceptual, and strategic problem-solving abilities
  • Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical architectures, risks, and AI strategies into clear, actionable business insights for non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership

title: AVP-Product Sales Specialist - Predictive Model
raw_description:
Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to manage and optimize the organization's analytics solutions portfolio by driving product strategy, commercialization, performance monitoring, and operational excellence.

 

The role is responsible for identifying market opportunities, translating business problems into analytics-driven solutions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable products powered by data, AI, predictive modeling, and advanced analytics. It also establishes governance and best practices to ensure consistent product quality, efficient execution, and continuous improvement across the analytics portfolio.

 

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Analytics Solutions Product Management
  • Manage the lifecycle of analytics-based solutions from ideation, enhancement, commercialization, and post-launch optimization.
  • Analyze product, commercial, and customer performance to identify growth opportunities, adoption trends, and improvement initiatives across the analytics solutions portfolio.
  • Collaborate with Data Science, Engineering, Product, Sales, Growth, Marketing, and external partners to translate business challenges into scalable analytics solutions.
  • Support the development and commercialization of AI, predictive modeling, geospatial, customer intelligence, and other data-driven solutions that leverage internal and external datasets.
  • Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking, and customer discovery to identify new business opportunities, use cases, and product enhancements.
  • Define business requirements, product positioning, pricing recommendations, packaging strategies, and go-to-market support for analytics solutions.
  • Develop dashboards, KPIs, and reporting frameworks to monitor product adoption, revenue performance, customer engagement, operational health, and business impact.
  • Evaluate customer feedback, usage patterns, and commercial performance to recommend feature enhancements, model improvements, or service optimization.
  • Work closely with technical teams to prioritize product roadmap initiatives and ensure solutions align with customer needs, data governance standards, and business objectives.
  • Support proof-of-concepts (POCs), pilots, and production deployments by coordinating cross-functional stakeholders throughout implementation and post-launch review.

 

Requirements

  • Minimum S1 degree from a reputable university, majoring in Business Management, Data, or Information Technology.
  • At least 5 years of experience in sales or similar roles, preferably with exposure to government sector projects.
  • Strong knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, database, and presentation software.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with government stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with telecommunications products and services.
  • Strong projection and forecasting skills to drive business growth.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

title: AVP Head of E2E Network Validation & Program Management
raw_description:
Role Purpose

The detail of jobs description as AVP Head of E2E Network Validation & Program Management

  • E2E Commercial Governance & Gatekeeping: Acts as the ultimate gatekeeper for all network CAPEX/OPEX investments, enforcing strict End-to-End (E2E) commercial governance and contract/commitment compliance
  • Strategic Investment Proposals: Leads the validation of proposed technical network solutions and translates them into comprehensive, highly profitable investment proposals to secure management approval
  • Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Optimization: Ensures all proposed program rollouts and vendor/partner commitments are strictly aligned with IOH's Annual Operating Plan (AOP), maximize the utilization of existing corporate assets, and deliver optimized TCO
  • Planning PMO & Cross-Domain Orchestration: Serves as the central Planning PMO, responsible for stitching together, orchestrating, and monitoring E2E cross-domain network programs (including RAN, Transmission/TX, and CME/Power) from inception to execution
  • Executive Visibility & Alignment: Provides high-quality executive management reporting and real-time dashboards to ensure absolute alignment, transparency, and strategic visibility at the senior leadership level

Minimum Requirements

Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (B.Sc.) or Master’s Demaster’s degree Telecommunication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or Business Management.
  • Fluency in professional written and spoken English is strictly required (for executive-level reporting and stakeholder presentation)
  • Strong team leadership, project management, and resource orchestration capabilities
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to distil complex technical/financial data into clear executive insights for senior management
  • High leadership capability and eagerness to quickly grasp new technical, financial, and strategic knowledge in fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
  • Enthusiastic, positive, and demonstrates strong sense of absolute ownership and proactiveness in driving cost-saving initiatives and operational controls

 

Related Experience:

  • Minimum 6–10 years of professional experience in Telecommunication industry, specifically within Network Design, Planning, or PMO areas
  • Solid experience in Technology Planning, Tech Strategy, and Network Strategic Sourcing is highly preferred and would be a strong advantage
  • Direct experience in managing end-to-end Bill of Quantities (BoQ) validation, rate benchmark checking, and asset inventory control/governance
  • Solid experience as Program Management Office (PMO) lead, orchestrating cross-functional network rollouts (including RAN, Transmission/TX, and CME/Power domains)
  • Proven experience in developing, maintaining, and presenting executive management reports and dashboard systems to provide strategic progress visibility to Senior Management

 

Skills:

  • Advanced knowledge and experience in telecommunications principles, covering technical designs, network strategy, and business aspects
  • Advanced understanding of End-to-End (E2E) Network Architecture, transport network principles, CME/power design principle and structural cost-saving strategies
  • Advanced knowledge of 4G and 5G network design principles, dimensioning, and capacity planning
  • Advanced understanding of BoQ structures, vendor pricing models, CAPEX/OPEX modelling, and developing robust commercial business cases
  • Highly proficient in operating MS Office Suite (advanced Excel/PowerPoint) and professional telco analytics/dashboarding tools (e.g., Tutela, PowerBI, or similar systems) to build executive reporting dashboards
  • Strong PMO skills with the ability to orchestrate cross-functional teams, manage inter-dependencies, and conduct critical path analysis

 

 

Skills

Program Management
Governance
Project, Program and Portfolio Delivery

Competencies

Continuous Improvement
Continuous Learning
Planning and Organizing
Decision Making
Building Positive Working Relationships

Job Responsibilities

Project Planning and Scheduling
Risk Management and Issue Resolution
Resource Coordination and Team Leadership
Process Assessment and Analysis
Process Improvement Design
Quality Assurance and Control

title: AVP-Head of B2B Strategy & Insight
raw_description:
Role Purpose

Lead the B2B Strategy & Insight function by driving strategy formulation, business performance management, KPI governance, market and competitive intelligence, insight (internal and external) and translating them to strategic transformation office (TO) activities.

The role is responsible for translating corporate strategy into executable business plans, monitoring strategic initiatives, ensuring KPI achievement, and translating market and customer insight into clear staretgic choices, and orchestrating execution through transformation-office-style function.

The role holder shall be comfortable to act as a key thought partner on growth, competitiveness, and long‑term direction of B2B.

Key Responsibilities

1.Strategy Development & Business Planning

  • Develop long-term and annual B2B strategy.
  • Lead annual business planning process.
  • Develop strategic initiatives.
  • Build business cases for investment.
  • B2B Strategy Roadmap
  • Annual Business Plan
  • Strategic Initiative Portfolio

2.Business Performance & KPI Management

  • Define and manage divisional KPIs.
  • Monitor monthly KPI achievement.
  • Develop performance dashboards.
  • Identify performance gaps and corrective actions.
  • KPI Dashboard
  • Monthly Performance Report
  • Executive KPI Review

3. PMO & Strategic Projects & initiatives tracking

  • Establish PMO governance.
  • Monitor strategic project execution.
  • Track milestones, risks, issues and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives.
  • PMO Dashboard
  • Project Status Report
  • Risk & Issue Log

4. Market Intelligence & Business Insight

  • Conduct market analysis.
  • Monitor industry trends.
  • Benchmark competitors.
  • Identify growth opportunities.
  • Market Insight Report
  • Competitor Analysis
  • Opportunity Assessment

5. Executive Reporting & Strategic Governance

  • Prepare Board materials.
  • Support management meetings.
  • Coordinate strategic governance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Quarterly and Yearly workshop. 
  • Board Deck
  • Executive Presentation
  • Governance Report
  • Updated strategic direction

Qualification

Qualification:
-    Bachelor’s degree in engineering, telecommunication, business management, economics, or related field

title: Sr Officer-Network Operation Assurance
raw_description:
Job Description

  • The Senior Officer – Network Fault Management is responsible for ensuring end-to-end network availability through proactive fault detection, incident management, service restoration, and continuous operational improvement. The role leverages artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and advanced analytics to predict network failures, accelerate root cause identification, reduce mean time to restore (MTTR), and improve customer experience across core, RAN, transport, IP, and infrastructure.
  • Ensure network communications run efficiently and effectively. You will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and resolving issues within the network infrastructure to minimize disruptions to service and maintain high levels of network performance and availability. This includes managing incidents, managing problems, and improving those problems. 
  • Continuously monitoring the health and performance of the network. Proactive monitoring allows early detection of potential issues before they escalate into major outages.
  • Identifying the root cause of incidents to prevent them from recurring. involves analyzing incident data, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions to address underlying problems.
  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date documentation on systems, configurations, and procedures are essential for efficient. troubleshooting and knowledge sharing.

 

Qualification:

  • Minimum bachelor’s degree in engineering, telecommunication, IT related field.
  • Fluent in English both oral and written.
  • Solid integrity, professionally and personally.
  • Strong initiatives in self-development.
  • Commitment to quality and timely result of the works.
  • A good communication especially in English.
  • Able to work independent and under pressure.

 

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of working experience in Transport/RAN/Core and platform equipment.
  • Minimum 10 years experiences in Network function in Telco company.

 

Skills:

  • Analytical Thinking, Customer Oriented.
  • Able to operate Operating System, MS, Office Application, etc.
  • Able to operate Craft Terminal (LCT/NCT), Management System (NMS), etc
  • Understand technology of Transport (DWDM, SDH, MW, IP, Core, etc) & understanding E2E telcos network.
  • Artificial intelligence enabler

 

Related Experience:Experience with incident, problem management processes, L2/3 support, ITIL framework, and service management principles is preferred.

Skills:Technical proficiency, troubleshooting skills, Problem solving, analytical thinking, teamwork, attention to details, communication, documentation, customer focus, data analysis, continuous learning, Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent are a plus.

Competencies

Analysis
Quality Orientation
Continuous Improvement
Collaborating
Applied Learning

title: Sr Officer-Retail Store App Development
raw_description:
Role Purpose

The purpose of the Retail & Store System Integration role is to serve as the strategic architect of the IOH Retail & Store System (Owned Store, Direct Sales, Partner Store) journey including supporting system such as (POSS, Queueing System, Digital Vending Machine, Siebel, Logistic/ERP), ensuring the application is both a commercial powerhouse and a user-friendly tool.

  • Conduct deep-dive assessments of IOH Retail & Store Application Ecosystem (POSS, Queueing Management, Digital Vending Machine) and user feedback to identify friction points within the application, translating complex metrics into actionable development insights.
  • Lead an iterative "test and learn" approach, consistently refining application features to stay ahead of evolving technology and shifting market demands.
  • Prioritize the user experience to ensure the application isn't just functional but also fostering trust and stability from daily use by Agent & Customer.
  • Ensuring all technical implementations are aligned with broader commercial objectives, contributing to the bottom line and maintaining a competitive edge in the market.
  • Orchestrate complex project timelines and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality application enhancements on schedule and within scope.

 

  1. Scope

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Software Development & Delivery Leadership
  • Lead and manage agile development teams delivering retail platform features
  • Oversee the full software development lifecycle (planning, coding, testing, deployment)

Product & Business Alignment
  • Work closely with business users to understand feature requirements and business goals
  • Translate business needs into clear technical solutions and implementation plans
  • Prioritize technical deliverables to balance speed, quality, and value

Platform Modernization & Innovation
  • Drive modernization initiatives such as microservices, API-first design, and cloud-native solutions
  • Explore and incorporate emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML, personalization, real-time analytics)
  • Promote continuous improvement through innovation and technical excellence

 

 

Requirements

 

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or equivalent field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience working in delivering Retail Store Ecosystem (POSS, Queueing System, Digital Vending Machine) and digital solutions, especially on mobile and web-based applications
  • Deep knowledge of Siebel CRM, Logistic/ERP & eKYC Biometric Verification Technology
  • Deep knowledge of system integration using common communication methods such as SOAP and JSON
  • Knowledge and able to work with Agile Approach
  • Team player on project-based delivery
  • Understanding security principles integrating single page apps, mobile apps, and third-party systems using OAuth2, SSO, JWT.
  • Understanding of Microservices architecture and patterns, micro gateway, docker, Kubernetes fundamental.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills and capabilities
  • Target oriented problem-solving approach and decision-making capabilities.
  • Deep knowledge on navigating the UI/UX requirement using Figma and translates into technical requirements.

 

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years' hands-on experience in solutioning, architecting and delivering mobile app and website products.
  • Product Development, Product management capability, especially on telecommunication industry
  • Preferably had various assignments in different functions in Marketing or having experience in working in highly dynamic companies
  • Deep understanding of the telecommunication and competitive landscape in Indonesia
  • Highly experienced in leading cross functional teams

 

Skills:

  • Agile leaner and responsive to feedback
  • Collaborative team player
  • Ability to plan holistically
  • Quality & Results Orientation

Proactive to ensure goals are met and we stay ahead of the competition

title: AVP-Digital Opex Management
raw_description:
Long Description

About the Role

The AVP Digital Opex Management is responsible for leading operational expenditure (Opex) planning, governance, monitoring, and cost optimization across the Technology organization. This role ensures effective budget utilization, financial discipline, and sustainable operational spending while supporting the organization's digital and technology objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead annual Digital IT Opex and Finance Lease planning aligned with business priorities and operational requirements.

title: Medco E & P Indonesia - Heavy Duty Equipment & Lifting Specialist (TPC)
raw_description:
Medco E & P Indonesia is looking for an experienced Heavy Duty Equipment & Lifting Specialist to join our team through a Third-Party Contract (TPC). In this role, you will contribute to Sakakemang PSC, an upstream oil and gas project located in South Sumatra and operated by MedcoEnergi. Currently in the development phase, the project is progressing toward First Gas/First Production, with start-up targeted for Q3 2027.


In this role, you will lead the planning, execution, and supervision of heavy lifting operations and heavy equipment activities, ensuring the highest standards of safety, technical excellence, and operational reliability throughout project execution.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and review lifting engineering plans for critical lifting activities, including heavy structures, pipelines, and processing modules.
  • Ensure lifting operations comply with company standards, international codes, and project requirements.
  • Oversee the integrity, certification, inspection, and maintenance of cranes, lifting equipment, and heavy machinery.
  • Serve as the technical authority for complex lifting operations, ensuring safe execution in both greenfield and brownfield environments.
  • Drive HSSE excellence by leading risk assessments, enforcing lifting safety requirements, and exercising Stop Work Authority when necessary.
  • Monitor contractor performance and verify the competency of lifting supervisors, riggers, and crane operators.
  • Promote a strong safety culture through technical audits, toolbox talks, and continuous improvement initiatives.
raw_requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in the oil & gas industry, including at least 7 years as a Lifting Specialist/Engineer on gas production facility projects.
  • Proven experience supporting onshore gas pipeline installation and heavy static equipment installation.
  • Certified Lifting/Rigging Engineer or Appointed Person from an internationally recognized organization (e.g., LEEA, LOLER, or OPITO). Indonesian Kemnaker/MIGAS certification is an advantage.
  • Proficient in lifting design and planning software, with strong knowledge of international lifting standards (e.g., ASME B30, ASME B31.8, API RP 2D).
  • Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and decision-making skills.


Disclaimer: The selected candidate will be engaged on a contract basis through a third-party company appointed by MedcoEnergi. This role supports MedcoEnergi's projects and business objectives, and is delivered in alignment with the Company's standards, governance, and operational requirements.

AVP of Commercial (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

As

AVP of Commercial

, you will lead and integrate SawitPRO’s

Customer Experience, Commercial, B2B Sales, Customer Management, Growth, Marketing, and Performance

functions into one cohesive strategy.

You will be responsible for building and scaling SawitPRO’s relationship with key stakeholders across the palm oil ecosystem, particularly

Palm Oil Mills, mill suppliers/agents, FFB Ramps, and other B2B partners

.

This role combines

commercial leadership and customer experience

, with a strong focus on driving customer acquisition, engagement, retention, revenue growth, and long-term ecosystem development.

You will work closely with the CEO and other senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and other functions to translate customer and market insights into business growth and strategic outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Experience & Commercial Strategy

Develop and execute SawitPRO’s overall

Customer Experience and Commercial strategy

, aligned with the company’s business objectives.

Own the end-to-end customer journey, from

customer acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, growth, to retention

.

Identify opportunities to improve customer experience while maximizing commercial value and revenue.

Develop strategic initiatives, new channels, business models, and partnerships to accelerate growth.

Build and continuously improve the roadmap and budget for the Experience and Commercial portfolio.

2. B2B Sales & Customer Management

Own the commercial relationship with SawitPRO’s key B2B customer segments, including

Palm Oil Mills, suppliers/agents, FFB Ramps, and other supply-chain stakeholders

.

Develop strategies to acquire, activate, grow, and retain B2B customers and partners.

Understand customer motivations, pain points, business opportunities, competitive landscape, and growth potential.

Build long-term strategic relationships with key customers and ecosystem partners.

Optimize revenue opportunities across the existing customer base.

Establish a strong customer service and relationship management approach to ensure high customer satisfaction and retention.

3. FFB Commercial Growth

Lead the commercial strategy for

FFB source acquisition, conversion, and customer management

.

Identify and develop new markets, customer segments, partnerships, and distribution channels to expand SawitPRO’s FFB ecosystem.

Build strategic partnerships with mills, suppliers, ramps, and other relevant stakeholders.

Work closely with internal teams to accelerate the acquisition and activation of FFB sources and maximize their commercial potential.

4. Customer Growth & Engagement

Drive customer growth through

customer intelligence, growth marketing, engagement programs, partnerships, campaigns, and ecosystem development

.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Kreativitas Pemasaran - Mengawasi, membimbing, dan mengarahkan hasil kreatif dari seluruh kampanye pemasaran SawitPRO, baik secara online maupun offline.

Kreativitas Desain Produk - Melakukan audit dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan terhadap desain produk yang dikembangkan oleh tim Product Management.

Tim Loyalty Management - Membantu dalam proses ideasi, pembuatan, dan perancangan konsep-konsep baru yang inovatif untuk mendorong pertumbuhan program loyalitas.

Tim Customer Experience - Bekerja sama dengan tim eCommerce dan Sales untuk menciptakan ide-ide kreatif yang dapat meningkatkan penjualan produk eCommerce maupun produk offline. Meningkatkan keterlibatan dan loyalitas pelanggan.

Kreativitas Operasional - Bekerja sama dengan tim operasional untuk merancang dan menghasilkan cara-cara kreatif dalam menjalankan operasional bisnis, mulai dari pengelolaan kantor, pengumpulan umpan balik pengguna, pengiriman produk, hingga penyelenggaraan webinar bagi pengguna.

Mengawasi tim lintas fungsi yang terdiri dari Graphic Designer, Copywriter, Social Media Specialist, Photographer/Videographer, dan Product Manager dalam pengembangan strategi komunikasi serta hasil kerja yang akan disampaikan.

Menyelenggarakan sesi brainstorming bersama tim kreatif dengan tetap menerapkan pemikiran strategis untuk menghasilkan inisiatif yang inovatif, dapat diterapkan, dan tetap mempertimbangkan efisiensi anggaran.

Menunjukkan kepemimpinan dan kemampuan manajemen tim yang memadai dalam mendorong pelaksanaan ide-ide kreatif di dalam tim kreatif.

Kualifikasi

Pendidikan

Gelar Sarjana (S1) di bidang Computer Graphics, Game Design, Graphic Design, Industrial Design, Product Design, Interior Design, atau bidang seni kreatif lainnya.

Pengalaman

Minimal 10 tahun pengalaman bekerja sebagai Copywriter, Graphic Designer, Production Artist, Game Designer, Sketch Artist, Interior Designer, atau bidang kreatif terkait.

Memiliki pengalaman dalam mengembangkan model bisnis yang inovatif serta mengembangkan saluran bisnis, model bisnis, atau transformasi bisnis.

Memiliki pengalaman di industri yang berorientasi pada konsumen seperti Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), perbankan konsumen, asuransi digital, FinTech, sharing economy, dan sejenisnya menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan desain kreatif mulai dari tahap ide hingga implementasi.

Memiliki pengetahuan tentang industri kelapa sawit menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai berbagai saluran komunikasi, pemasaran, dan periklanan, baik online maupun offline.

Memiliki pengalaman yang terbukti dalam mengelola tim, stakeholder, serta mengawasi proyek desain berskala besar.

Pengetahuan/Keterampilan

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai perilaku, motivasi, dan karakteristik manusia.

Memiliki kemampuan kreativitas visual dan desain grafis yang sangat baik, serta memahami penggunaan warna, tipografi, tata letak, bahasa, persepsi manusia, dan elemen desain lainnya.

Memiliki pemahaman bisnis yang kuat, termasuk pengetahuan spesifik mengenai industri manufaktur, perusahaan berbasis sumber daya alam, serta unit bisnisnya.

Memiliki kemampuan berpikir kreatif, analitis, strategis, konseptual, serta keterampilan konsultasi yang sangat baik.

Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tulisan yang sangat baik, termasuk kemampuan menjelaskan konsep serta teknologi digital kepada para pemimpin bisnis, maupun menjelaskan konsep bisnis kepada berbagai pihak.

Memiliki semangat yang tinggi, idealisme yang kuat, serta visi untuk berkontribusi dalam mewujudkan masa depan Indonesia yang lebih baik.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO adalah perusahaan inovatif yang berkomitmen untuk meningkatkan kualitas hidup seluruh pelaku di industri kelapa sawit. SawitPRO mengembangkan platform agrikultur terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir (end-to-end), yang menciptakan manfaat bagi manusia, lingkungan, dan keberlanjutan bisnis. Misi kami adalah meningkatkan kesejahteraan pekebun kelapa sawit swadaya di Indonesia, membuka peluang nilai tambah bagi industri, serta mendorong daya saing di pasar global melalui penerapan ketertelusuran (traceability) dan keberlanjutan produk kelapa sawit.

Kami menyediakan platform yang menghubungkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam rantai pasok industri kelapa sawit, seperti Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), agen, pekebun swadaya, dan penyedia sarana produksi pertanian. Kami membangun ekosistem digital yang menghilangkan hambatan dalam proses bisnis serta meningkatkan produktivitas pekebun melalui akses terhadap sarana produksi pertanian berkualitas dengan harga terjangkau, layanan agronomi, dan benih unggul berkualitas tinggi.

Kami memiliki visi untuk menjadi penggerak perubahan yang mampu meningkatkan taraf hidup pekebun swadaya sekaligus membantu mewujudkan pemenuhan kebutuhan global akan minyak sawit berkelanjutan.

title: E-Commerce Executive (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

E-Commerce Executive (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (Full WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Primary Responsibilities

Own, lead and drive the eCommerce business of SawitPRO called Toko Sawit

To drive the online demand for goods and services sold by SawitPRO

Work with different departments to ensure a comprehensive eCommerce strategy for capturing market share, market development and sales of toko Sawit

Ensure high adoption of Toko Sawit

Define the SLAs for Toko Sawit online business

Work closely with operations team to ensure on-time fulfillment of online orders

Own P&L responsibility of Toko Sawit constantly driving towards higher revenues and profits

Role of the eCommerce Executive

eCommerce Strategy

- Develop, own and constantly update end to end eCommerce business strategy for Toko Sawit through innovation and creativity

Customer Experience Management

- Ensure highest standards of online shopping experience for Toko Sawit customers

Category Management

- Ensure the most sought after products are always listed in the product catalog of Toko Sawit. Continuously source for high revenue, high profit products to be listed on Toko Sawit

Revenue Management

- Come up with innovative pricing strategies for products to optimise revenues while serving the

best price guarantee

of SawitPRO

Sales Growth

- Maximise sales revenues for online sales through constant growth of customer base, product catalog, best pricing and customer satisfaction

User adoption

- Ensure high levels of recurring revenue from the existing users, referral business and other strategies for highest standards of user adoption

Promotions and marketing

- Work with marketing team to launch innovative online marketing campaigns and promotions for building the SawitPRO and Toko Sawit brands

Partnerships

-

Collaborate with partnership team to maximise online to offline (O2O) sales, revenues and profits

Performance monitoring

- Constantly monitor Toko Sawit performance to ensure maximum availability of Toko Sawit products. Close inventory monitoring with the operations team to maximize product availability across all regions

eCommerce Loyalty

- Develop loyalty programs for online shopping

Execution KPIs

– clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organization

P & L

- Manage revenue and costs generated from the online user base

Kualifikasi

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business or Marketing discipline is required.

Experience

Min. 2 years’ experience working in eCommerce business, preferably with some independent P&L responsibilities

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Palm oil industry knowledge would be helpful

title: Head of Smallholder Relationship (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Smallholder Relationship (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (Full WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

About The Job:

As a Head of Smallholder Management in SawitPRO, you will play a pivotal role in managing a team with focus building and maintaining positive relationships with palm oil smallholders, enabling us to deliver meaningful support and resources to enhance their agricultural practices and economic opportunities. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of smallholder farming communities, excellent communication skills, and a strong commitment to social impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead, coach, and mentor a team of smallholder management professionals, providing guidance, support, and feedback to help them achieve their goals.

Set clear performance targets for the smallholder management team, monitor performance against targets, and take corrective action as needed.

Develop and manage the budget, forecasting revenue and expenses to ensure financial targets are met.

Build and maintain strong relationships with smallholders, especially with our users, by providing support, guidance, and assistance to address their needs and challenges.

You will join the KebunPRO Delivery Engineering team, responsible for configuring, integrating, and migrating customer environments during the onboarding of large estate-owner accounts, working alongside the Delivery Manager, Field Customer Support Engineers, and Product Engineering.

You will be responsible for:

Configuring and setting up backend environments and services for new KebunPRO customer accounts during the delivery lifecycle.

Designing, building, and executing data migration pipelines to move estate, plantation, and workforce data from customer legacy systems into KebunPRO.

Developing and maintaining backend integrations between KebunPRO and third-party or customer systems (e.g. ERP, HR, IoT/sensor data sources).

Participating in kickoff and discovery sessions to translate customer requirements into technical configuration and integration plans.

Supporting go-live and hypercare stages by resolving backend defects and data issues quickly to keep implementation timelines on track.

Writing and maintaining API specifications and technical documentation for each customer delivery.

Performing unit and integration testing for delivery-specific configurations and integrations.

Collaborating with Product Engineering to escalate and resolve product-level gaps discovered during delivery.

Providing technical support on on-call rotations for customers in active delivery or hypercare.

Kualifikasi

Possess at least an Advanced Diploma, Bachelor's Degree, or Master's Degree in Computer Science / IT, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication), or equivalent.

At least 2 years of working experience in backend software development.

Good knowledge of and familiarity with Golang; experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases.

Experience with data migration, ETL processes, or system integration work is a strong plus.

Experience working with Source Control (Git).

Experience working with Webservices integration (REST and SOAP) and API responses (JSON and XML). Experience with OpenAPI 3.0 is a plus.

Good discipline in writing unit tests and integration tests.

Experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS is a plus.

Proficiency with AI-augmented software engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, or Antigravity to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation.

Good interpersonal skills, a team player, and able to work independently and directly with customers during time-boxed delivery engagements.

title: Senior Insider Threat Engineer
raw_description:
Senior Insider Threat Engineer

Team

Security

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

The Insider Threat Management team is part of Cyber Defense. We protect Grab's people, data, systems, and customers from risks involving trusted users, compromised identities, data misuse, privilege abuse, and latest AI-enabled threats.

We are an evidence-led, engineering-focused team. We combine behavioural analytics, threat hunting, investigations, and security controls to detect meaningful risks early while respecting privacy, due process, and legitimate business activity.

You will work with Security Engineering, Enterprise Security, Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Security, Data Governance, Privacy, Legal, People, and AI teams across Grab.

Get to Know the Role

You will help build and operate Grab's insider threat detection and investigation capabilities across identity, endpoints, cloud services, SaaS applications, enterprise systems, data platforms, and AI environments.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. You will turn complex and sometimes ambiguous threat scenarios into measurable signals, scalable detections, investigation workflows, and preventive controls.

You will report to the Lead of Insider Threat Detection. This is an onsite role based in Jakarta.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will design, build and improve behavioural detections for data misuse, unusual access, excessive downloads, unauthorised data movement, credential misuse, privilege abuse, and attempts to bypass security controls.

You will lead complex technical investigations and proactive threat hunts, correlating identity, endpoint, network, cloud, SaaS, application, and data-access telemetry to reconstruct user activity and assess risk.

You will develop queries, scripts, data pipelines, risk-scoring models, and automation to improve telemetry enrichment, alert quality, case triage, investigation speed, and detection coverage.

You will partner with Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Security, Data Governance, and Enterprise Security teams to identify and address gaps across DLP, CASB, SIEM, UEBA, EDR/XDR, cloud, and data-protection controls.

You will develop detection scenarios for Generative AI, large language models, AI agents, and Shadow AI, including sensitive-data exposure, misuse of enterprise AI capabilities, and AI-assisted attempts to evade security controls.

Senior Workplace Technology Engineer

Team

Technology Solutions

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) provides secure, reliable, and intuitive workplace technology experiences for Grab employees. The Workplace Technology team owns the physical and digital workplace capabilities that ensure collaboration across offices, meeting rooms, event spaces, and hybrid working environments. We partner with business leaders from Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, IT, Corporate Security, Procurement, and external technology providers to create consistent and scalable workplace experiences across Grab.

Get to Know the Role

You will support the delivery and operation of Workplace Technology across Grab offices. Your scope will include office-build technology, AV infrastructure, physical security infrastructure, vendor coordination, and project delivery.

We are looking for sound technical judgement, strong stakeholder coordination, and a willingness to work on-site. You will provide the human accountability needed to assess site conditions, validate installations, resolve physical infrastructure issues, and make informed decisions during projects and incidents.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Workplace Technology. The role is based in Jakarta and may require travel to support critical projects across Grab's regional offices.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Deliver workplace technology for office builds, expansions, renovations, and refresh, from site assessment through handover.

Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot AV systems, meeting-room technology, displays, collaboration equipment, and related infrastructure.

Support physical security infrastructure delivery and operations, including access control, CCTV, visitor-management devices, and associated site hardware.

Coordinate site access, installation windows, safety requirements, business downtime, testing, commissioning, and project handover.

Manage vendors and contractors, validate installation quality, track defects, and ensure delivery meets agreed scope, cost, timeline, and technical standards.

Resolve hardware, AV, security, and network-adjacent infrastructure incidents; and maintain accurate technical documentation.

Maintain project trackers, risks, dependencies, asset records, and status updates for assigned workplace technology projects.

Use AI and automation to improve documentation, reporting, knowledge management, and routine workflows, while applying human judgment for on-site and business-critical decisions.

title: Sales & Distribution Engineer
raw_description:
S & D Engineer

Job Role:
A hands-on technical role supporting the configuration, integration, and day-to-day delivery of distribution systems within the telco ecosystem. The role sits between business requirements and system implementation — executing configuration tasks, building and testing integrations, and troubleshooting data flow issues across DMS, ERP, and BSS layers under the guidance of senior engineers.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Requirement Support: Help gather and document business requirements for Sales and Supply Chain systems, and translate them into clear technical specifications and configuration tasks.
  2. System Configuration: Perform configuration of Distribution Management Systems (DMS) and support their integration with ERP and BSS layers for subscriber activation and financial posting.
  3. Integration & Interface Testing: Build, test, and troubleshoot API integrations between DMS, ERP, and Telco BSS — using Postman to validate endpoints, interpreting API specifications, and verifying request/response payloads to ensure data integrity.
  4. Delivery Support & Troubleshooting: Execute assigned tasks within system enhancement projects, run data validation queries, inspect application logs, and produce flowcharts/documentation for distribution scenarios.

Educational Background & Experience:

  1. Academic: Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Computer Science, Informatics, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, or Mathematics/Statistics.
  2. Professional Experience: 1–3 years of experience in systems integration, application support, or supply chain/distribution technology. Fresh graduates with strong hands-on technical skills and relevant internship/project experience will be considered.

Hard Skills (Technical Competence):

  1. API & Integration: Practical experience testing and troubleshooting APIs with Postman; ability to read and interpret API specifications (REST/SOAP, JSON/XML) and trace integration issues across system interfaces.
  2. Database: Ability to write and run SQL queries (SELECT, JOINs, filtering, aggregation) against distribution/subscriber data. Familiarity with Oracle SQL/PL/SQL is a plus.
  3. Unix/Linux: Comfortable working on the command line for everyday tasks — navigating the filesystem, inspecting and grepping log files, checking process/service status, and basic troubleshooting.
  4. Process & Documentation: Ability to map processes and create technical flowcharts; familiarity with requirement/ticketing tools (e.g., Jira) and configuration modules in distribution platforms.

title: Mass Market & CVM Engineer
raw_description:
Mass Market & CVM Engineer

Job Role:
A hands-on technical role focused on the Mass Market segment — supporting the configuration, delivery, and troubleshooting of prepaid and Customer Value Management (CVM) products and campaigns. The role sits between commercial/marketing requirements and the underlying telco systems, turning product ideas into working configurations and ensuring offers, bundles, and campaigns run correctly end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Product Configuration: Configure and maintain mass market prepaid products — tariffs, bundles, packages, and promotions — across the relevant provisioning, charging, and campaign systems, ensuring they behave as defined in the commercial brief.
  2. CVM Campaign Support: Support the setup, targeting, and execution of CVM campaigns (segmentation, offers, triggers).
  3. Requirement Translation: Work with commercial and marketing teams to understand product requirements and translate them into technical configurations, test cases, and clear documentation.
  4. Delivery & Troubleshooting: Execute assigned configuration and integration tasks, run validation queries, inspect logs, and troubleshoot issues in prepaid activation, charging, and campaign delivery flows.

Educational Background & Experience:

  1. Academic: Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Computer Science, Informatics, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, or Mathematics/Statistics.
  2. Professional Experience: 1–3 years of experience in telco product configuration, prepaid/charging systems, campaign management, or application support. Fresh graduates with strong technical fundamentals and relevant internship/project experience will be considered.

Hard Skills (Technical Competence):

  1. Telco Product Knowledge: Solid understanding of mass market prepaid products — tariffs, bundles, balances, validity, and the prepaid subscriber lifecycle — and how these are configured and provisioned in production.
  2. Configuration & Campaigns: Ability to configure products and CVM campaigns hands-on, define segmentation/targeting logic, and validate offer behavior across channels.
  3. API & Integration: Practical experience testing and troubleshooting APIs with Postman; ability to read and interpret API specifications (REST/SOAP, JSON/XML) and trace issues across system interfaces.
  4. Database: Ability to write and run SQL queries (SELECT, JOINs, filtering, aggregation) to validate subscriber and campaign data and investigate discrepancies.
  5. Unix/Linux: Comfortable on the command line for everyday tasks — navigating the filesystem, grepping and inspecting log files, checking service status, and basic troubleshooting.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with Ericsson DMP (Data Management Platform) or equivalent CVM/campaign management platforms.
  • Exposure to charging systems (e.g., OCS/PCEF), provisioning, or BSS interfaces in a mass market context.
  • Understanding of subscriber segmentation and offer-management concepts.

title: AVP-Account Director
raw_description:
Role Summary

The Account Director is responsible for strategic client management, ensuring long-term client satisfaction, revenue growth, and acting as the main liaison between clients and internal teams.

Find and pitch complex opportunities from existing or Greenfields Account. Orchestrating with internal and external stakeholder for Core, ICT and IoT and Techco project

 

The role consists of: nurturing and fastening large enterprise account to use Indosat B2B products & services, a “close win”. All team members approach with effective and efficient manner, increase the exposure of Indosat B2B products & services in the marketplace and customer centric focus to maintain loyalty.

Responsibilities:

Sales Execution

  • Plan and execute corporate sales activities for Indosat Business services.
  • Evaluate and create program to improve customer productivity in term of services usage.
  • Coordinate with Enterprise Sales Solution, Marketing, Product Development, Technical and other supporting functions concerning proposal preparation of offering solution and pricing that needed by customer.
  • Coordinate with Major Events to retain customer and increase customer loyalty.
  • Evaluate achievement of target production and revenue from Customer in Bank and Financial Segment

Account Management

  • Prospecting customer and regularly update customer with Indosat B2B products and services
  • Manage sales plan with sales team
  • Validate & update customer credit rating
  • Manage sales team activities
  • Manage all sales team pipeline & sales forecast
  • Cross/Up Selling
  • Manage Bid
  • Develop Sales Project Proposals
  • Manage sales workforce
  • Manage sales performance

Customer Management & Market Analysis

  • Conduct reporting of the sales activities and performance
  • Perform account monitoring and maintenance, Give feedback to Marketing, Product Development and Technical functions concerning trend of service need, market pricing and customer potential.

Sales & Campaign Management

  • Issue and Distribute Marketing Collaterals
  • Manage and track leads

Lead, initiate, and accomplish strategic project with strategic customers.

  • Initiate new project, conducting and lead the action involving marketing, presales, provisioning after-sales team.

Team collaboration

  • Execute and achieve functional goals given by Head of Division (Superior)
  • Work co-operatively with other team members to accomplished delegated tasks assigned by managers
  • Provide support, when appropriate, for the team in cases of absence or unavailability
  • Provide continuous inputs on business process and systems improvement

 

Minimum Requirement

  • Minimum Bachelor Degree in any major
  • 7+ years of B2B Tech sales experience with experience in selling ICT, Telco products to Government Accounts.
  • Previous experience as a sales executive, sales manager, account manager for multi segment, or presales/sales consultant/project management. Preferably coming from SI company have an engineering knowledge
  • Proven knowledge and experience in Techo solution
  • Proven ability in monitor and evaluate the performance, make recommendations and also ability to give right direction and use initiative and judgment
  • Having knowledge about the B2B business model and sales methodology
  • Good Networking and Engagement with Top Level in Financial Segment
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets
  • Experience managing mid-to-large accounts independently
  • Strong capability in end-to-end sales cycle
  • Solid negotiation and client management skills
  • Experience handling strategic or high-value accounts
  • Strong consultative selling and solution positioning capability
  • Ability to manage complex stakeholder environments
  • Good communication, negotiation, presentation, and report writing skills
  • Good analytical thinking
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain a strong sales pipeline
  • Flexible and adaptable in under pressure situations and meet short- and long-term deadlines
  • Able to use Microsoft office (excel, ppt, doc, etc)

title: AVP-Technical Business Development Specialist (Cybersecurity)
raw_description:
Role Purpose

Own the Security-led growth engine within the Technical Business Development unit to deliver realized revenue for Indosat Business. This role acts as a Strategic Solution Lead and Commercial Architect, bridging the gap between complex Cybersecurity principles and scalable revenue. The AVP is responsible for translating complex security technology into business outcomes, shaping high-value opportunities early with BD and Sales, and ensuring the successful adoption of the security portfolio within the B2B segment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Incubate and shape high-value opportunities: Lead customer/opportunity discovery sessions to validate business outcomes, identify stakeholders, and build a clear value storyline before the formal proposal stage
  • Translate architecture into business value: Translate complex security principles (e.g., Cybersecurity, SOC, CTI, IAM, Network Security, and Cloud Security) into business-ready narratives that focus on ROI, TCO, and customer pain points.
  • Support Sales, Presales, and Product teams: Act as a opportunity shaper, help define solution direction, scope, and commercial approach early so opportunities are proposal-ready and deliverable.
  • Own security pipeline governance: Maintain high-integrity pipeline data (especially strategic pipelines), ensuring stage discipline, risk tracking, and accurate revenue forecasting for leadership.
  • Validate solution logic: Handle key technical objections at an architectural level to ensure the security solution is fit-for-purpose and aligns with the customer's strategic objectives

Job Summary

  • Revenue & Adoption Delivery: Deliver IOH Business revenue target by operationalizing Security-led opportunities into realized billing.
  • Opportunity Shaping: Incubate strategic deals early to improve win probability, validate solution direction, and shorten the sales cycle.
  • Governance & Reporting: Maintain high-integrity pipeline governance to drive prioritization and provide leadership with predictable forecasts.

 

Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Business.
    • Background in Sales Specialist, Technical Sales, Cybersecurity Product, Security Presales, or Security Solution Architect roles with a strong cybersecurity knowledge, and adequate communication skill, commercial and revenue orientation.
    • Professional security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, or vendor-specific certifications from Palo Alto, Fortinet, or Cisco) are highly regarded.
    • 7+ years of experience in the Cybersecurity and enterprise solutions ecosystem.
      • Proven experience in opportunity shaping and managing multi-stakeholder customer engagements.
      • Experience in translating customer painpoints into deliverable security roadmaps.

title: Officer-Sourcing Circle
raw_description:
Job Description

 

Manage end-to-end sourcing and procurement activities, including tender management, supplier selection, commercial negotiations, contract and purchase order administration, vendor performance management, and cost optimization, ensuring the best Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), timely project delivery, and alignment with business objectives.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Sourcing & Tender Management

  • Manage end-to-end sourcing activities, including RFP/RFQ preparation, tender execution, supplier evaluation, and vendor selection.
  • Review and validate Bill of Quantities (BoQ) and Scope of Work (SoW) submitted by users.
  • Launch and manage tender processes through Coupa and other approved procurement platforms.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and vendors throughout the procurement cycle.

2. Commercial Negotiation & Cost Optimization

  • Analyze supplier proposals and commercial bids.
  • Lead price, contract, and commercial negotiations to achieve targeted cost savings and optimal TCO.
  • Recommend vendor awards based on commercial, technical, quality, and performance considerations.
  • Support procurement initiatives that drive operational efficiency and cost reduction.

 

Job Description

 

3. Contract & Purchase Order Management

  • Prepare and process Purchase Orders (POs) and contracts in accordance with company policies and timelines.
  • Monitor contract execution and vendor compliance.
  • Ensure timely delivery of procured products and services to support business requirements.

4. Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Maintain effective communication and relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Resolve vendor-related issues, including vendor blocking and performance concerns.
  • Act as the company's representative in external procurement and supplier engagements.

5. Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare weekly procurement reports and ad-hoc reports as requested by management.
  • Support process improvement initiatives to enhance procurement effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with procurement policies, procedures, and governance standards.

6. Team Collaboration

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve departmental and organizational objectives.
  • Provide procurement support and guidance to business users.
  • Contribute to team initiatives and successfully deliver assigned tasks and projects.

Minimum Requirement

 

Qualification:

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering, or other relevant disciplines. Relevant postgraduate qualification will be an advantage.

 

Experience:

  • Minimum 1 year of relevant working experience in Procurement, Sourcing, Supply Chain, or related functions, with demonstrated negotiation skills and strong commercial acumen.
  • Experience in managing spend categories related to Sales & Marketing, such as BTL Printing, Branding, Event Activation, POSM, Media Placement, and similar categories.
  • Exposure to Network and Facility-related procurement categories will be an added advantage.

 

Skills:

  • Critical Thinking - Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.
  • Understand the business process as well as end to end process of RFP/RFQ system.
  • Able to work effectively with stakeholder, management, and suppliers  
  • Team player with good working conduct and ethics coupled with ability to manage pressure
  • Possess high standard of personal and professional integrity
  • Good of both written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia and English
  • Good in presentation skills both written & oral and be familiar with Microsoft Excel, Power Point and Word software

title: VP-Head of Infrastructure
raw_description:
Job Summary

As an IT Infrastructure/Systems Architect, you are responsible for designing and developing the core technical platforms and services that underpin the organization’s business processes and data management. The main purpose of this role is to ensure that IT infrastructure components—including hardware, software, and communication networks—are effectively mapped and integrated to support seamless operations and strategic objectives. Key areas of focus include analyzing technology interactions and dependencies to achieve optimal integration, compatibility, and system performance. You will also evaluate different IT platform and infrastructure alternatives, assessing their total cost of ownership and return on investment to inform decision-making. This role requires close collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that IT systems are scalable, efficient, and aligned with organizational goals.

 

Job Description

 

Requirements Gathering and Stakeholder Engagement

Oversee the requirements gathering process, ensuring that all stakeholder needs are addressed and requirements align with the overall business strategy.

 

Current State Assessment

Oversee and ensure completion of a thorough IT infrastructure assessment that aligns with organizational requirements.

 

Architecture Design and Planning

Approve IT infrastructure architecture designs and ensure alignment with business objectives and technical standards.

 

Technology Evaluation and Selection

Make final decisions on IT platform, hardware, and software selections, ensuring alignment with organizational strategy and budget constraints.

 

Integration and Implementation Planning

Oversee the planning process and approve the final implementation roadmap for infrastructure integration and deployment.

 

System Performance Optimization

Oversee achievement of performance targets and establish continuous improvement processes for infrastructure optimization.

 

Governance and Continuous Improvement

Lead infrastructure governance processes, approve standards, and oversee continuous improvement efforts.

 

Skill

Business & Technology Strategy

API & Integration Engineering

Infrastructure Operations & Site Reliability

IT Governance, Risk & Compliance

Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering

Network & Telecom Engineering (RAN, Core, Transport)

Project, Program & Portfolio Delivery

DevOps, CI/CD & Automation

AI / Advanced Analytics Enablement

IT Service Management & FinOps

Product Management & User Experience

 

Competencies

Operational Decision Making
Innovation
Customer Service Orientation
Entrepreneurial Insight
Business Insight
Leading Execution
Continuous Learning
Driving for Results

title: Officer - Digital Business Growth GTM & Campaign Delivery
raw_description:
Role Purpose

To lead the end-to-end go-to-market planning and campaign delivery for B2C Indosat Official WhatsApp channels (IM3 and 3ID), driving seamless commercialization, scalable annual revenue growth beyond 5Mn USD, and optimal customer experiences across digital and assisted touchpoints. This role translates business priorities into actionable GTM-launch plans while orchestrating cross-functional execution across Commercial, CVM, Product, Tech, Data, Customer Service, and external partners. Additionally, the candidate will conduct agile assessments & execution to unlock new revenue streams, optimize channel assets, and maintain strict governance over project timelines, stakeholder collaboration, digital transformation metrics, and CSAT targets.

Minimum Requirements 

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, plus 2+ years of experience in digital channel management, GTM execution, or conversational messaging (telecom, e-commerce, digital-first business or digital platform experience preferred).
  • Technical Proficiency: Proven track record in campaign operations, launch readiness, and vendor coordination, with strong skills in data-driven campaign optimization and basic SQL querying.
  • Competencies & Execution: Highly adaptable team player with exceptional interpersonal and organizational skills, capable of delivering agile results in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Language Proficiency: Professional English fluency (Minimum IELTS 7.0+ or TOEFL 600+).

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Commercial & GTM Execution: Expertise in go-to-market planning, campaign delivery, and revenue optimization across digital customer lifecycles.
  • Data & Analytics: Proficiency in performance monitoring and basic-to-intermediate SQL/BigQuery data querying to drive business decisions.
  • Stakeholder Management: Competent communication, presentation, and cross-functional coordination capabilities.
  • Ownership & Execution: Adept ownership, analytical problem-solving, and agile execution in fast-paced environments with quality-oriented deliveries.
  • Experience with AI technologies or AI-driven solutions is a plus

Secondary Competencies

  • Market & Commercial Acumen: Proven sales or marketing experience with a deep understanding of marketing principles (digital & traditional), commercial strategies, and market research methodology.
  • Analytical & Technical Mastery: Proficient analytical skills with demonstrated fluency in statistical techniques and data-driven problem-solving.
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Strong interpersonal and communication capabilities, enabling seamless cross-level collaboration and a customer-centric focus.
  • Self-Drive & Execution: High initiative with the ability to operate independently and lead structured coordination in dynamic settings.

raw_description:
Long Description

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of FTTH and FWA technologies and network architecture principles.
  • Strong understanding of B2B business and solution
  • Professional certification in Network Engineering
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for telecommunications.

 

Experience:

  • Has extensive experience at least 5 years of experience in telecommunications network planning and engineering, multiple business unit background of working experiences in HBB & B2B would be an advantage
  • Experience in capacity planning and performance optimization transport for broadband networks.
  • Hands-on experience with cost estimation and budgeting for large-scale network projects.
  • Familiarity with emerging home broadband technologies and industry trends.

 

Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to design efficient network solutions.
  • Has excellent reporting, presentation and persuasion skill capabilities.
  • Has excellent knowledge of telecommunication business & process in general.
  • Has broad knowledge of technology roadmap especially in HBB and B2B requirements.
  • Has excellent knowledge in translating business requirement into technical or functional specification.
  • Has strategic thinking of end-to-end demand lifecycle process (requirement, solution and delivery), budget, governance and resources.
  • Has strong business and financial acumen with a sense of shareholder responsibility

 

 

Long Description

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Strategic Planning
  1. Establish divisional KPI based on organizational scorecard and cascaded down the teams for HBB & B2B Planning task
  2. Manage division budget based on work-plan and control the utilization/realization of it

 

  • In order to ensure division operates on budget and help contribute to organizational goals

HBB & B2B Network Planning and Solutions
  1. Capture HBB & B2B business requirements and align with stake holder internally IOH and CKH/OG counterparts, ensuring that the local requirements of IOH are taken into account and the right solutions aligned with B2B business objective in 1 -5 years roadmap.
  2. Align with HBB & B2B and all stake holder including subsidiaries to have synergy and  best solutions and ensure the solution is feasible, implemented and operational running smoothly and competitive in the market. Target FMC (fixed Mobile Convergence) to lock the customer always stay with IOH is the ultimate target
  3. Setup right design principle on HBB, SLA and KPI to drive the partner to deliver for best network in class with the contiguous improvement plan

 

Team Management
  1. Develop and mentor team member(s) to achieve divisional objectives
  2. Monitor and evaluate the performance of staff, make recommendations to supervisor and implement actions, such as promotions and dismissals
  3. Provide feedback to SVP to work with HR team to create the succession plan for the function/ organization and attract, motivate and retain top talent to ensure alignment with the plan

 

In order to ensure talents are attracted, retained developed to meet organizational needs

External Relation
  1. Serve as a company representative for external related functions
  2. To manage the partnership with HBB & B2B 3rd party to have the right operartion model and design principle

 

In order to build good network in the industry and keep the performance and CX in the best quality

Job Description

Lifestyle & AI Growth Manager 

  • Lead end-to-end go-to-market (GTM) execution for new AI partner products within the mobile app ecosystem.
  • Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns from ideation through launch, optimization, and post-campaign evaluation.
  • Drive strategic alignment with external partners to identify growth opportunities, define business initiatives, and achieve shared objectives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure timely campaign setup and seamless execution.
  • Analyze customer journeys and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to design and optimize the end-to-end product experience, improving user engagement and conversion.
  • Monitor campaign performance through regular reporting and funnel analysis, leveraging digital marketing insights to identify optimization opportunities and improve business outcomes.
  • Continuously evaluate app touchpoints and customer interactions to enhance discoverability, engagement, and partner product performance.

 

Qualification

:-Minimal Bachelor's Degree-Minimal 5 Years of Experience

-Understand full funnel marketing & end-to-end product journey

-Understanding of AI & OTT products are a plus (but not mandatory)

-Work experience mainly in digital ecosystem (app, website) 

Competencies

Adapt quickly when priorities or conditions change.
Analysis
Build strong working relationships with people from diverse backgrounds.
Business Awareness
Customer Excellence
Driving Execution
Deliver strong results even under tight deadlines or pressure.
Entrepreneurship
Growth Mindset
Strategic Planning

title: VP-Head of Financial Non Bank
raw_description:
Role Purpose

VP-Head of Sales is responsible for leading multiple sales teams through Sales Managers to drive segment-level revenue growth, strategic account expansion, and long-term customer value.
This role focuses on defining and executing sales strategies across a portfolio of accounts, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and market opportunities. VP-Head of Sales provides direction and oversight to AVP-Head of Sales or any Account Directors, ensuring consistent execution of account plans, pipeline development, and performance management across teams.
In addition, the role requires strong engagement with senior customer stakeholders, guidance on complex sales opportunities, and oversight of forecasting and business performance. VP-Head of Sales acts as a key link between senior leadership and the sales organization, ensuring strategies are effectively translated into execution and delivering sustainable business growth.

Job Details

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop end-to-end IT solutions for B2B Financial Non Bank clients.
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  • Identify technological enhancements to drive operational efficiency and customer value.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to understand client needs and strategic direction.
  • Conduct client meetings to gather requirements and present solution options.
  • Provide technical support in client presentations and negotiations.
  • Define project scope, objectives, technical requirements, timelines, and budgets.
  • Align internal teams and resources based on project milestones.
  • Monitor and report project progress against targets.
  • Stay current with trends and emerging technologies in supply chain, energy, and digital transformation.
  • Proactively recommend innovations and technology applications.
  • Drive digital enablement across B2B client solutions.
  • Coordinate across IT, product, and operations teams to ensure solution delivery.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams during solution development and implementation.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to solution architects and analysts.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or relevant field is preferred.
  • Minimum 12–15 years of professional experience in IT solution development, enterprise systems, digital infrastructure, ICT, cloud computing, ERP
  • At least 5-7 years in a leadership role managing large-scale, cross-functional projects
  • Proven experience in designing and implementing technology-driven solutions for B2B clients in the Financial Non Bank sector
  • Strong background in working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders
  • Strategic thinking and commercial acumen in B2B technology environments.
  • Strong project management and budgeting skills.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, cost-effective technical solutions.
  • Leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional team collaboration abilities.
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, client-driven environments.
  • Proven track record in driving segment/portfolio-level revenue growth
  • Strong experience in strategic account management and large-scale deals
  • Experience leading large sales organizations or multi-region coverage
