title: Searah Muara Bakau - Flow Assurance Engineer
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the role of Flow Assurance Engineer


Purpose:

  • To provide specialistic engineering input to the project activities starting from the screening studies up to the completion of the execution phase, as direct performer and/or as monitoring/follow-up of the activities performed by others (i.e.  contractors), and direct execution of Flow Assurance studies/analyses. 
  • To ensure follow-up of Development Projects at the FEED stage, performed externally, with quality verification of the results delivered in preliminary and final form. 
  • To provide definition of the Scope of Work documents for external activities. 
  • To review and approve the specification, design and supply, ensuring that it meets project objectives, industry standards and best practice for safety, reliability and cost. 
  • To support Troubleshooting activities through the analysis of field data and provide operational recommendations, both from HQ and on site. 
  • To provide specialistic support to the technical Authority in projects review to ensure technical integrity, to commissioning and start-up, and to production in trouble shooting activities on facilities already in operation. 

 

General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Technical integrity of Flow Assurance design.
  • Overall effectiveness and efficiency of Flow Assurance design.
  • Capturing and dissemination of Flow Assurance engineering knowledge.

 

Key activities:

  • Selection of the best technical/ economical solutions for a production facility.
  • Flow Assurance of overall design integrity and compliance with international standards, company guidelines, and engineering best practices
  • Direct and supervise Engineering Detail Contractors during the design, procurement, and construction activities, ensuring the quality of the works according to the contract requirements.
  • Providing technical input, in line with project requirements, into technical studies and Basis of Design for onshore and offshore production and processing facilities.
  • Ensure a smooth and effective transfer of data and information between Contractors and between Contractors and the Company.
  • Identify and create/adopt appropriate Flow Assurance engineering standards, with due consideration of the environmental and logistic conditions of the equipment.
  • Define Flow Assurance requirements.
  • Provide guidance & supervision to the 3D Model Review and related follow-on activities.
  • Optimize installation and construction activities/ sequences, minimize cost and safety risks.
  • Participation in process safety review activities.
  • Act as a technical authority on Flow Assurance issues for operational support.
  • Participation in technical integrity activities and reviews/ audits.
  • Train/ mentor junior engineers.
  • Coordinate with Subsurface engineers regarding completion, well testing and workover interventions; Production and Reservoir engineers; and Production Chemistry specialists in chemical analysis, monitoring and evaluation.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

Education: Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent subjects.

Professional Qualification:

  • Minimum of 3 years of working experience in Oil & Gas offshore and onshore projects.
  • Design experience concerning platform topside units / FPSO’s / subsea manifolds/ flexible umbilical/ flowlines and flow assurance studies on subsea pipelines including deep water.
  • Preferably, participation in offshore/onshore operations, either for problem-solving or for commissioning / start-up.
  • Preferably, participation in asset integrity and safety.
  • Previous experience as a supervisor of engineering design contractors for offshore facilities / pipelines.

Language

•      Plant Design

Knowledge from other Professional Areas

•      HSE Principles and Systems

•      Production Operations

•      Asset Integrity

Business Line-Specific Skills

Upstream:

•      Reservoir Management & Evaluation

•      Drilling & Well Completion Activities

 

Non-Technical Competencies

  • Problem-solving and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve control system issues during offshore activities.
  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate with cross-functional teams  
  • Positive Attitude
  • Energy

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Business Platform
raw_description:
Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Business Platform

Team

Engineering

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Business Platform team in Jakarta, Indonesia. The Business Platform powers the backend capabilities that enable businesses and enterprises to onboard, operate, grow, and serve consumers at scale across Southeast Asia.

Get to Know the Role

In this role, you will design, build, and evolve backend platform services that manage business profiles, store metadata, business configuration, and related operational workflows. You'll work on systems that sit close to the source of truth for business data and workflows—systems that directly influence how businesses set up their operations, how internal teams operate reliably, and how downstream products consume trusted business information. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong ownership, system design thinking, and a commitment to building platforms that simplify complexity rather than spread it around. This is an onsite role based in Jakarta.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Lead the architectural design of microservices, high-throughput APIs, and data storage solutions built to handle scale and high availability.

Diagnose high-stakes performance bottlenecks, refactor core infrastructure, and ensure low latency across distributed systems.

Own end-to-end delivery of mission-critical systems—from writing technical design documents (TDDs) and scoping projects to deploying and maintaining production features.

Drive code quality across the team through high-bar code reviews, system reliability standards, and technical mentorship of mid/junior engineers.

Oversee cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), automated CI/CD pipelines, security protocols, and robust incident management/observability to guarantee strict SLAs.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

5+ years in backend/platform engineering with high-scale production systems.

Strong proficiency in Go, Java, or Kotlin.

Deep knowledge of distributed systems, service-oriented architecture, microservices, APIs, data modeling, and eventual consistency.

Tech Stack:

Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, caching, and observability.

title: Manager, Strategic Projects
raw_description:
Manager, Strategic Projects

Team

Business Strategy

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

The Grab Support - Strategy team works with senior leaders across the organisation to drive impactful projects that enhance our service offerings, ensuring all our users feel supported and valued. Our culture is entrenched in collaboration and a customer-centric approach in delivering world-class support to our customers and partners.

Get to Know the Role

As a Manager, Strategic Projects, you will be reporting into the Senior Manager, Strategic Projects and work onsite in the Grab office. You'll manage projects end-to-end to drive user value and experience through building strategic plans, deep diving into processes and existing setup, and working with cross-functional teams to deliver changes that drive user experience. You'll also conduct analyses and uncover key customer insights through analytics to inform decision-making processes and make recommendations.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Own projects / problem areas end-to-end —

develop the diagnosis, propose roadmap, and success metrics, then support regional and country leadership alignment behind it. Synthesise operational and behavioural data across markets to identify issues and resolutions

Lead multi-country, cross-functional delivery —

work with multiple teams across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Operations to launch solutions and ensure successful project outcomes

Shape Customer Experience — d

esign and deliver on improved user experiences by leading design thinking workshops, conducting analyses to identify root causes, and iterative product launches

Hold the line on user safety and quality —

ensure every proposed change is assessed for its effect on user trust, safety, and support quality before it ships

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

At least 5 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or an in-house strategic projects / transformation function, including time owning a programme end-to-end rather than a single workstream

Demonstrated ability to influence key stakeholders

title: AVP-M2M Product Development
raw_description:
Key Responsibilities

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Understanding the M2M/IoT market.

Assessing the M2M/IoT market, both the national market and global market.

M2M products development & innovation.

Develop new products and assess the use case in the market.

Enhance existing M2M products to increase the product's value in the market.

Work closely with the SIM vendor during development and enhance M2M products.

Product Management.

Take ownership of the M2M product and deliver with good quality.

Perform presentations and demonstrations of solutions to potential and external clients.

Support sales for meetings with customers.

Analyze customers’ business and industry needs and propose products and solutions accordingly.

Make a detailed and accurate analysis of business needs.

Ability to write technical requirements and understand required changes to existing documents to address customer needs.

Support the M2M team and sales to write technical specifications in terms of product and customer requirements.

Provide technical support and consulting to customers and internal teams.

Collaborate with external parties, vendors, and industry partners to provide optimal solutions.

Monitor M2M product and solution performance and make improvements according to customers’ requirements.

Generate & monitor solution performance reports

Increase industry knowledge and new technology to improve the quality of M2M products and solutions.

Competent and up-to-date industry knowledge.

 

Responsibilities

  1. Understand customer needs and present Appropriate solutions from the M2M product catalog
  2. Own the end-to-end lifecycle of M2M/IoT products, from launch to retirement
  3. Provide technical support and consulting to clients and internal teams.
  4. Manage projects and coordinate with partners & technical teams to implement solutions.
  5. Monitor solution performance and make improvements according to client requirements.
  6. Support the development and implementation of marketing strategies.
  7. Increase industry knowledge and new technology to build future-proof solutions
  8. Provide market feedback to the product teams to ensure our solutions remain relevant
  9. Create, implement & report budgets and cost plans for managed projects.
  10. P&L responsible for M2M portfolio.
  11. Track product performance metrics (revenue achievement, product P&L, etc.)
  12. Lead root cause analysis and resolution of recurring service issues.
  13. Monitor SLA compliance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

Qualification:
•    Bachelor’s/master’s degree in business management in IT/Engineering or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Informatics, and other related disciplines.

Related Experience:
•    At least 5 years of experience in a relevant portfolio.
•    Subject matter expertise in IoT/M2M and strong telecoms technical understanding.
•    Highly preferred coming from telco, IT Services, IT Consultant, and System Integrator.
•    Being experienced in the Product and Presales team is a plus.

Skills:
•    Understanding of the M2M/IoT market: Familiarity with the current state of the SIM and eSIM market as well as an understanding of the key trends and developments in space.
•    Business acumen: The ability to understand potential customers' business challenges and goals and translate those challenges into customer requirement specifications and provide the right solution to help the customer achieve their goals.
•    Technical expertise: A good understanding of the technical aspects of M2M/IoT solutions, including SIM and eSIM profiles & provisioning, applet, OTA, security, remote provisioning architecture, and devices.
•    Communication skills: Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills are essential for effectively communicating the value of M2M products and solutions to potential customers.
•    Solution design: Understanding of SIM and eSIM system design, integration, and deployment.
•    Proposal writing: Experience in writing proposals, pricing, and responding to RFPs and RFIs.
•    Project management: Understanding project management methodologies and tools
•    Understanding of ROI and TCO calculations
•    Familiarity with M2M/IoT solution sales cycles, pricing models, and contract negotiation.

Competencies

Technical Competencies:
1. Good understanding of relevant Global Platform, 3GPP, ETSI, and GSMA standards and specifications, and networks.
2. SIM Technology: Have a good understanding of 2G, 3G,4G, and 5G technology.
3. Knowledge of SIM/eSIM profile architecture and Remote SIM Provisioning (RSP) architecture (eSIM M2M, eSIM Consumer, and eSIM IoT).
4. Experience with OTA: Over-the-Air SIM Update (RFM/Remote File Management and RAM/Remote Application Management).
5. Security: Understanding SIM security such as SCP02, SCP03, SCP80, SCP81.
6. Troubleshooting: Able to troubleshoot SIM cards at the APDU level.
7. Project management: Understanding of project management methodologies and tools, such as Agile and Scrum, used to manage M2M projects.

title: AVP-Business Development
raw_description:
Job Details

Overview

Responsible for driving business solutioning growth within his/her vertical industry by enabling them to drive business growth, build strong partnerships, and contribute to the overall success of the organization. They specialized develop a network of contacts to attract clients, research new market opportunities and oversee growth projects, making sales projections and forecasting revenue, in line with projected income.

Requirements

Qualification:

  • Bachelor in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, Informatics System or a related field. An MBA or relevant master’s degree can be advantageous.
  • Certifications in project management and business analysis are preferred.
  • Specialized knowledge in specific vertical industry, such as: Financial Services, Supply Chain, Government, and Energy

Experience

  • Work experienced as Account Manager, Business Development, Business Analyst, Product Manager in Solution Services or from reputable consulting service in Technology
  • Work experienced within vertical industry as employee min 5 years

Skills

  • Has broad relationship to private sectors or Government
  • Updated technology trends, especially in ICT Business
  • Experienced in project delivery
  • Multitasking tasking solved
  • Able to drives revenue growth (result oriented) while ensuring seamless collaborations

Responsibilities

  • Lead generation & account planning : Account Planning, industrial expert based on technology trends, fact Findings from client pain points and insight info, triggering new business initiatives with clients, orchestrating client requirements and internal capabilities
  • Solution design & architecture (RFPs): Defining clear problem statement based on customer’s pain points/ needs, solutioning driven by recommending solution best practices and involving the required pre-sales experts based on customer needs, joint planning sessions for lead sharing and pursuing integrated opportunities
  • Commercial proposal (RFQs): Responsible for putting together the client proposal (solution design, pricing, etc.), boxed solutions to be priced based on a predefined price list, bespoke services to be priced by Business Development and Solution Architect
  • Client negotiation: present the solution to the customers and negotiate contract (with help from other functions as needed), responsible for contract signing & booking
  • Service delivery: as part of steering committee, to align between delivery and plan
  • Renewals: involved reviewing on renewals

title: Sr Officer-ERP System Support
raw_description:
Role Purpose

To act as the primary Person In Charge (PIC) for the ERP platform on the IOH side, serving as the key functional and technical point of contact between business users, IT, and the Managed Services Partner (vendor/mitra). This role is responsible for day-to-day platform ownership — including business requirement coordination, master data and configuration integrity, and cross-module functional oversight — as well as governing the partner's delivery of L1, L2, and L3 Application Managed Services (AMS) across the ERP ecosystem, System Integration, on prem/cloud infrastructure related, middleware, ensuring operational stability, SLA compliance, effective Change Request (T&M) delivery, and adherence to IOH governance, reporting, security, and service acceptance (BAST) standards.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the single Point of Contact (PIC) for ERP system matters on the IOH side; gather and consolidate business requirements from process owners; prioritize and validate enhancement/CR proposals prior to partner execution; safeguard master data, Chart of Accounts, and configuration integrity across modules; provide functional guidance to business users on system usage and process alignment, system integration, and infrastructure utilization awareness.
  • Act as the primary IOH counterpart for the ERP Ecosystem Managed Services Partner; monitor day-to-day delivery of L1/L2/L3 support across ERP ecosystem, Surrounding system, system integration, infra utilization, license monitoring; ensure the partner operates within the agreed operating model, service window, and escalation matrix.
  • Monitor and validate the partner's compliance to SLA targets (response/resolution time per P1-P4, System and integration uptime, First Time Fix Rate); review incident trend and aging-ticket reports; drive corrective action for SLA breaches.
  • Oversee incident and problem management performance across L1/L2/L3 tiers; validate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and CAPA for P1/P2 incidents; review and endorse Change Request documentation (FDS/TDS), T&M consumption, and enhancement delivery against approved scope.
  • Coordinate impact assessment, regression testing, and stabilization activities for ERP system mandatory quarterly cloud updates; ensure partner readiness and risk mitigation prior to patch deployment.
  • Lead and/or participate in daily operational standups, weekly service reviews, the monthly Executive Steering Committee, and the quarterly Patch & Strategy Alignment forum with the partner; consolidate reporting for management visibility.
  • Ensure the partner adheres to IOH IAM/MFA access standards, data confidentiality requirements, and change governance (no production change without an approved CR and roll-back plan); maintain audit evidence of access and change activities.
  • Validate monthly service evidence (SLA summary, RCA/CAPA, ticket tracker, UAT sign-offs) submitted by the partner and process monthly BAST acceptance in line with IOH governance standards.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ERP/IT operations, including at least 2 years in ERP system (Oracle Fusion ERP & EPM) implementation, support, or vendor/managed services governance within a large enterprise environment. Experience overseeing L1/L2/L3 Application Managed Services and SLA-based vendor management is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP/EPM modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, PPM, Procurement, Tax, FCCS/TRCS/EDMCS), OCI infrastructure, and OIC integration concepts; understanding of ITSM/ITIL incident, problem, and change management processes; SLA and vendor performance management; strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills; proficient in MS Office and reporting tools; good command of English (written and verbal).

raw_description:
Task & Responsibilities of Mgr Corp. Sustainability I :

  • Coordinate the preparation and publication of the companys sustainability report in accordance with applicable regulation and international framework, including POJK, GRI, IFRS and ISSB
  • Monitor and analyze new OJK regulation related to sustainability reporting and act as Indofood coordinator to ensure compliance with these new requirement is implemented.
  • Serve as Project Manager or the implementation of IFRS S2 - Climate related disclosures, witch will become mandatory under OJK regulation for fiscal year
  • Serve as primary point of contract for sustainability related inquires from investor, ESG rating agencies, NGOs, Government bodies and other external stakeholders

  • Coordinate with consultans and third party partner
  • Collaborate with cross functinal teams across the group to implement sustainability programs
  • Develop and deliver training and knowledge sharring sessions to promote sustainability.
  • Support preparation of periodic progress reports to monitor the implementation of sustainability initiatives agains established targets
  • Lead the development and management of sustainability content on the corporate website
  • Develop key communication materials to support sustainability programs and corporate initiatives.
raw_requirements:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Environment/ Environmental Engineering/ Sustainability with a minimum GPA of 2.75
  • At least 5 years of experience in sustainability reporting and disclosure with at least 2 years in Sustainability Manager role. Working knowledge of POJK requirement, Global reporting Initiative (GRI), Sustainability Index and ESG rating.
  • Experience working with interdiciplinary teams (e.g., sustainability, procurement, product engineering, etc.) and managing relationships within complex organizational structures.
  • Familiar with consepts of ESG/ sustainability disclosure, including  POJK requirement, materiality, environmental, social, human right impact and governance
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to confidently facilitate working sessions with key stakeholders

title: Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Jambi)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Jambi)

Daftar Sekarang

Jambi, Jambi City, Jambi, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Mengidentifikasi dan mendapatkan prospek (lead) baru serta membangun basis pelanggan yang berkelanjutan.

Mengembangkan dan mengelola pipeline prospek untuk secara konsisten mencapai target bulanan.

Secara proaktif mencari prospek baru melalui berbagai strategi pendekatan langsung.

Mengelola seluruh proses penjualan, mulai dari kontak awal dengan prospek hingga proses penutupan penjualan.

Membangun dan menjaga hubungan yang baik dengan prospek, serta memastikan keterlibatan mereka selama seluruh siklus penjualan.

Mendukung aktivitas yang berorientasi pada pencapaian pendapatan sesuai dengan Business Plan perusahaan.

Bekerja sama dengan tim internal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi berjalan dengan lancar dan efektif.

Peran Sales Executive

Customer Service - Berfokus pada akuisisi dan retensi pelanggan melalui pendekatan layanan pelanggan yang berkualitas.

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pelanggan yang ada.

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang berkualitas melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan pengelolaan hubungan dengan pelanggan.

Kualifikasi

Gelar Sarjana (S1) dari semua jurusan.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan (Sales) atau Business Development. Kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman di industri agribisnis akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan peluang bisnis dengan hasil yang nyata.

Memiliki jaringan yang luas di industri kelapa sawit.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai industri kelapa sawit.

Mampu melakukan kegiatan canvassing dan wajib memiliki kendaraan pribadi.

Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris.

Bersedia ditempatkan di Jambi.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO adalah startup agritech digital hijau yang inovatif dengan kantor pusat di Jakarta. Misi kami adalah menjadi inovator terbaik yang mampu meningkatkan kualitas hidup seluruh pelaku di industri kelapa sawit. Melalui platform agrikultur terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir (end-to-end), kami menciptakan manfaat bagi manusia, lingkungan, dan keberlanjutan bisnis.

Kami menyediakan aplikasi terintegrasi yang menghubungkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam rantai pasok industri kelapa sawit, seperti Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), Agen DO, Pekebun Swadaya, Pemanen, Pengemudi, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Kami membangun ekosistem digital yang mampu meningkatkan produktivitas melalui dokumentasi pekerjaan yang lebih mudah, akses terhadap sarana produksi pertanian yang terjangkau dan terjamin keasliannya, serta layanan agronomis profesional.

Komitmen kami tidak hanya menghadirkan solusi yang inovatif, tetapi juga mendukung pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan industri kelapa sawit Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa melalui inovasi dan kolaborasi, kami dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi kehidupan setiap pelaku di industri kelapa sawit.

Daftar Sekarang

title: FFB Supervisor (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

FFB Supervisor (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Memiliki dan mengembangkan hubungan pelanggan dengan pelanggan B2B SawitPRO - terutama pemasok pabrik kelapa sawit (Pabrik CPO) yang dikenal sebagai Agen DO atau FFB Suppliers.

Mendorong strategi komersial SawitPRO, dengan fokus pada growth pendapatan, perluasan pasar, dan kemitraan strategis

Mengembangkan dan melaksanakan strategi komersial komprehensif yang selaras dengan misi SawitPRO untuk meningkatkan hubungan dengan Pemasok TBS

Mengidentifikasi dan mengejar peluang bisnis dan kemitraan baru untuk memperluas jejak SawitPRO di antara Pemasok TBS di wilayah tersebut

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pengguna

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan berkualitas tinggi kepada pemasok TBS melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan manajemen hubungan

Mempelajari tingkat motivasi masing-masing pemangku kepentingan pabrik, titik kesulitan mereka, peluang bisnis dan prospek growth

Kolaborasi antar tim di seluruh produk, penjualan, operasi, sales, dan teknologi untuk meningkatkan pemahaman yang baik tentang pelanggan

Menjaga komunikasi yang efektif dengan Pemasok TBS untuk memastikan kebutuhan mereka terpenuhi dan masalah apa pun yang mungkin timbul dapat diatasi. Memastikan Pemasok dikelola secara efisien, dengan fokus pada pencapaian target keuangan dan bisnis

Membantu waktu riset pelanggan dengan pengembangan dan implementasi strategi klien, termasuk riset pasar, riset pesaing, dll.

Membantu tim pemasaran dengan identifikasi audiens target, perencanaan dan pelaksanaan kampanye.

Memastikan semua data dan informasi klien akurat dan terkini, serta semua laporan klien disiapkan dan diterima tepat waktu.

Kualifikasi

Pendidikan minimal S1 dari semua Jurusan

Minimal pengalaman 5 tahun bekerja di bidang manajemen bisnis, customer service, growth, sales, dll.

Pengalaman di bidang kelapa sawit (FFB Purchase) diutamakan

Bersedia untuk melakukan perjalanan dinas di luar kota

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

Memiliki dan mengembangkan hubungan pelanggan dengan pelanggan B2B SawitPRO - terutama pemasok pabrik kelapa sawit (Pabrik CPO) yang dikenal sebagai Agen DO atau FFB Suppliers.

Mendorong strategi komersial SawitPRO, dengan fokus pada growth pendapatan, perluasan pasar, dan kemitraan strategis

Mengembangkan dan melaksanakan strategi komersial komprehensif yang selaras dengan misi SawitPRO untuk meningkatkan hubungan dengan Pemasok TBS

Mengidentifikasi dan mengejar peluang bisnis dan kemitraan baru untuk memperluas jejak SawitPRO di antara Pemasok TBS di wilayah tersebut

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pengguna

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan berkualitas tinggi kepada pemasok TBS melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan manajemen hubungan

Mempelajari tingkat motivasi masing-masing pemangku kepentingan pabrik, titik kesulitan mereka, peluang bisnis dan prospek growth

Kolaborasi antar tim di seluruh produk, penjualan, operasi, sales, dan teknologi untuk meningkatkan pemahaman yang baik tentang pelanggan

Menjaga komunikasi yang efektif dengan Pemasok TBS untuk memastikan kebutuhan mereka terpenuhi dan masalah apa pun yang mungkin timbul dapat diatasi. Memastikan Pemasok dikelola secara efisien, dengan fokus pada pencapaian target keuangan dan bisnis

Membantu waktu riset pelanggan dengan pengembangan dan implementasi strategi klien, termasuk riset pasar, riset pesaing, dll.

Membantu tim pemasaran dengan identifikasi audiens target, perencanaan dan pelaksanaan kampanye.

Memastikan semua data dan informasi klien akurat dan terkini, serta semua laporan klien disiapkan dan diterima tepat waktu.

Kualifikasi

Pendidikan minimal S1 dari semua Jurusan

Minimal pengalaman 5 tahun bekerja di bidang manajemen bisnis, customer service, growth, sales, dll.

Pengalaman di bidang kelapa sawit (FFB Purchase) diutamakan

Bersedia untuk melakukan perjalanan dinas di luar kota

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: PRIME NATUNA EP - Mooring Master (Prod Ops - Offshore)
raw_description:
Responsible to:

•  Safely plan, Coordinate, and Supervise all Tanker Mooring, unmooring, and Offloading Operations at the FPSO, ensuring effective Ship/Shore Interface, Compliance with Regulatory & Company HSES requirements, and Protection of Personnel, Environment, Assets, and Production continuity. 

• Safely plan, Coordinate & Supervise all Support Vessel Operation. 

• Safely Plan maintain FPSO stability, Cargo Management, Ballasting Management. Maintain all Cargo and Safety Equipment. 

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:   

• Accountable for the safe and efficient execution of FPSO Tanker Mooring, Unmooring, Hose handling, and Crude Oil Offloading Operations in accordance with approved terminal, Marine,    Cargo, and HSES Procedures. 

• Responsible for reviewing export Tanker suitability, confirming mooring arrangement, Tug/support Vessel readiness, manifold compatibility, Cargo Hose/Hawser condition, and completion of pre-Offloading checklists before Operations commence. 

• Responsible for maintaining continuous operational control during Tanker approach, connection, loading, disconnection, and departure, including monitoring metocean limits, Vessel position, Hawser load, Hose status, Communication links, and Exclusion Zones. 

• Competent to lead Marine Risk Assessments, Toolbox Meetings, Ship/Shore Safety Checks, SIMOPS Reviews, Permit Interfaces, and Operational readiness reviews for all Offloading-related activities. 

• Responsible for directing and coordinating Deck Crew, Hose handling Team, support Vessels, Export Tanker Personnel, Cargo Control, Maintenance Team, Marine Control and OIM during normal, Abnormal, and Emergency Marine Operations. 

• Accountable for ensuring mooring and offloading equipment defects, unsafe conditions, operational deviations, and equipment limitations are reported, risk assessed, and followed up through maintenance, corrective action, and Management of change processes as required. 

• Competent in Tanker Operations, Marine Pilotage Principles, FPSO Offloading Arrangements, Mooring Systems, Cargo Hose Handling, Emergency Disconnection, Spill Response, and relevant Industry Guidance including OCIMF and ISGOTT Good Practice. 

• Responsible for maintaining accurate Operational Records, Offloading Logs, Inspection Records, Vessel Acceptance Documentation, Incident Reports, and Handover Information to support Safe Continuity of Marine operations. 

• Responsible FPSO Stability, Cargo Management, Ballasting Management, Safety equipment. 

• Responsible for overseeing all support Boat Operational Performance; the Mooring Buoy maintenance and integrity also to all marine operations within the facility area. 

• Responsible for maintaining port Security within the Anoa Marine Terminal area as part of the PFSO (Port Facility Security Officer) ISPS Code Implementation
raw_requirements:
• Nautical Science Diploma (Min. ANT II)

• 10-15yrs Marine experience
• Master Mariner Certificate of Competency or equivalent Senior Deck Officer qualification, with valid STCW Certification and Tanker Endorsement appropriate to Crude Oil Tanker/Offshore Terminal Operations. 

• Proven Experience as Mooring Master, Loading Master, Tanker Master, Chief Officer, or Senior Marine Officer involved in FPSO/FSO, Offshore Terminal, Tandem Mooring, STS, SPM/SBM, or Crude Oil Offloading Operations. 

• Strong Working Knowledge of FPSO Marine/Offloading Systems, Export Tanker Operations, Cargo Hose Handling, Mooring Hawsers, Support Vessel Coordination, Ship/Shore Safety Checks, and Emergency Disconnection Arrangements. 

• Demonstrated Competence in HSES Leadership, Marine Risk Assessment, SIMOPS Control, Permit to Work Interfaces, Toolbox Talks, Stop-work Authority, Incident Reporting, and Emergency Response for MAE/MATTE Prevention. 

• Valid Offshore Safety and Medical Certification as required for FPSO Operations, such as BOSIET/FOET, HUET, Offshore Medical, and Site/Client Mandatory Safety Training. 

• Familiarity with applicable Marine and Tanker Industry requirements and Good Practice, including SOLAS, MARPOL, ISGOTT, OCIMF Guidance, Terminal Regulations, Company Marine Procedures, and Emergency Response Plans. 

• Strong Leadership, decision-making, situational awareness, Communication, and Coordination Skills, with the ability to Work Effectively Under Pressure in a Multicultural Offshore Environment. 

• Recognised Mooring Master, Loading Master, STS transfer, Large Tanker Mooring, Marine Pilotage, or FPSO Operations Training/Certification. 

• Significant Offshore Oil & Gas Marine experience, including Direct involvement in Tanker Vetting/Acceptance, Offloading Planning, Marine Assurance, Mooring Equipment Inspection, and Emergency Drills.

title: Head of Sales (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Sales (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Primary Responsibilities

To oversee and integrate SawitPRO's Commercial, Marketing, Demand Planning, Customer Management, B2B sales, Growth, and Performance Measurement functions into a cohesive strategy. Oversee function:

Customer Experience to manage the following for the customers (primarily B2B)

Customer research, Customer acquisition, Customer engagement, Customer relationship management and Customer retention

Customer growth, including Growth Marketing through the development of a partner ecosystem, Customer Intelligence and Customers’ competitor Intelligence

Customer engagement events and marketing campaigns

Role of the Head of Sales:

Strategy & Ideation – The person responsible must develop the overall strategy and ideas behind the company's brand, as well as its customer and employee experiences.

Team management – Lead a team of collaborators and contributors for delivering on all aspects of the experience portfolio (XP)

Leadership – demonstrate leadership by coming up with innovative ideas to further the goals of the experience portfolio across all aspects of the organisation

Roadmap development – Develop the roadmap and budget for managing the experience portfolio by optimising the return on investment

Execution KPIs – clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organisation

Senior Management collaboration – work closely with senior management, including the CEO, head of product, head of engineering, etc., to deliver on the strategic business outcomes, including owning financial KPIs and human KPIs

DDD – Lead the Data Driven Decision (DDD) making across the entire organisation. Utilise business intelligence and performance metrics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.

Experience gamification for optimised engagement of stakeholders across all aspects of the XP

Kualifikasi

Education

A bachelor’s Degree in Business or Marketing, or any related discipline, is required.

Experience

Min.  10 years’ experience working ideally in business management, Strong Marketing & sales/business Development, customer service, industrial design, etc., in driving digital initiatives with some independent P&L responsibilities

Five or more years of progressive leadership experience in leading cross-functional teams and enterprise-wide programs, operating and influencing effectively across the organisation and within complex contexts

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Experience in consumer industries like fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer banking, digital insurance, FinTech, sharing economy, etc., is preferred

Knowledge/Skills

Deep understanding of people and their motivations and behaviours

Ability to develop short interaction levers to drive strategic behaviours through gamification, rewards and engagement

Extensive knowledge of digital marketing, analytics, growth hacking and CRM.

Business-savvy strategic thinking: Big picture orientation and conceptualisation of ideas, conceiving effective strategies to drive growth and revenue generation

Strong business acumen, including domain-specific knowledge of the manufacturing and resources companies and their business units

Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual thinking and consulting skills.

Strong influence and negotiation skills

Ability to effectively drive people, process and technology change in a dynamic and complex operating environment

Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain digital technologies to business leaders and business concepts to technologists

Must be a passionate human being with strong idealism and vision for a brighter future for Indonesia

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil Industry.

Our mission is to develop an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for People, Planet and Prosperity. Our Vision is to help palm oil smallholders become more PROficient in farming practices, so that they can produce more FFB crop, resulting in greater PROsperity for indigenous communities, also creating PROfitability for our business, PROtection of the natural environment and PROgress of Indonesia

SawitPRO is a game-changer, improving the smallholders’ living standard and helping our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil through efficient land use.

Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to define and execute on the product roadmap.

title: Head of FFB & B2B Commercial (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of FFB & B2B Commercial (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Lead and drive SawitPRO's FFB (Fresh Fruit Bunch) crop commercial strategy, focusing on growth, market expansion, and strategic partnerships to support the acquisitions of FFB sources and funnel these sources into our partner mills.

Develop and execute a comprehensive commercial strategy that aligns SawitPRO's mission to enhance palm oil farming and business practices through increase in FFB growth in all stakeholders

Collaborate with product development and marketing teams to ensure product offerings meet market demands and customer needs.

Identify and pursue new business opportunities, markets, and partnerships to expand SawitPRO's footprint.

Own and develop the customer relationship for 3 distinct types of B2B customers of SawitPRO - Crude Palm Oil mills (CPO Mills), DO Agents/suppliers of CPO mills (suppliers), FFB Ramps and any other actors in the supply chain to help speed up acquisition and activation of the FFB sources.

Optimize and maximise revenue opportunities from the user base

Provide high quality customer experience through a combination of product, service and relationship management

Learn the motivation levels of each different types of customers, their pain points, business opportunities and growth prospects

Cross team collaboration across product, sales, operations, marketing and technology to promote good understanding of the customer

Be an ecosystem builder

Role of the Head, B2B Commercial

Strategy & ideation – The person responsible has to develop the overall strategy and ideas behind the company's FFB crop acquisition, conversion and customer management strategy

Team management – Lead a team of collaborators and contributors for delivering on all aspects of the business development and customer management

Leadership – demonstrate leadership by coming up with innovative ideas  as well as by building and managing a high performance team

Customer Management – Manage 3 distinct types of customers - Palm Oil mills, palm oil mill suppliers / agents, FFB Ramps and any other actors relevant to the FFB Crop Business

Customer Service - Focus on both customer acquisition and retention through a sound customer service approach

Execution KPIs – clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organization

Senior Management collaboration – work closely with senior management including the CEO, head of product, head of engineering, etc. to deliver on the strategic business outcomes including owning financial KPIs and human KPIs

DDD – Lead the Data Driven Decision (DDD) making across the entire organization. Utilize business intelligence and performance metrics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.

P & L - Manage revenue and costs generated from the customer base

CRM - Recommend, implement and own the Customer Relationship Management System for SawitPRO

Kualifikasi

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business or Marketing discipline is required.

Min.  10 years’ experience working in Sales, Commercial  business management, growth,, etc. in driving digital adoption among customers with independent P&L responsibilities

Five or more years of progressive leadership experience in leading cross-functional teams and enterprise wide programs, operating and influencing effectively across the organization and within complex contexts

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Experience in Sales of consumer industries like fast moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer banking, digital insurance, FinTech, sharing economy, etc. is preferred

Palm oil industry knowledge would be helpful (optional)

Deep understanding of people and their motivations and behaviours

Relationship building and management of different types of B2B customers

Strong business acumen, including domain-specific knowledge of the manufacturing and resources companies and their business units

Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual thinking and consulting skills.

Strong influence and negotiation skills

Ability to effectively drive people, process and technology change in a dynamic and complex operating environment

Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain digital concepts and technologies to business leaders, as well as business concepts to technologists

Must be a passionate human being with strong idealism and vision for a brighter future of Indonesia

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

title: Loyalty Intern (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Loyalty Intern (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Kota Pekanbaru, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Internship (Full WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Check & follow up claim rate reward emas petani melalui FFB Dashboard (Looker), memastikan poin & reward sesuai dengan data supply TBS

Check status PROTim yang belum konfirmasi, update melalui spreadsheet & FFB Dashboard

Check konten & reminder tim FFB terkait update data supply, melalui Instagram & spreadsheet

Rekap DO (Delivery Order) Mill Progress melalui sistem CRM, sebagai acuan validasi data supply TBS petani

Update & recap guest survey SNA 2026 melalui spreadsheet & Lark Base

Blasting informasi terkait poin, reward, dan program ke PROTim melalui WA & spreadsheet

Menyusun dan mengelola dokumen BAST melalui spreadsheet & Gdocs

Koordinasi rutin dengan tim FFB untuk mencocokkan dan merekonsiliasi data supply TBS agar perhitungan poin & reward petani akurat

Kualifikasi

Mahasiswa aktif (Diploma/Bachelor Degree) atau fresh graduate dari semua jurusan

Wanita

Terbiasa menggunakan Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel untuk input, hitung, dan rekap data

Memiliki ketelitian tinggi, karena berkaitan langsung dengan perhitungan poin & reward petani

Memiliki kepribadian yang supel, mudah bergaul, dan senang berinteraksi dengan orang lain

Good communication dan kemampuan koordinasi yang baik, karena akan sering berhubungan dengan tim FFB dan PROTim

Familiar dengan Instagram dan WhatsApp untuk keperluan kerja (reminder & blasting info)

Bersedia belajar tools baru seperti Looker Dashboard, CRM, dan Lark Base

Disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja dengan deadline

Detail oriented dan mampu bekerja secara terstruktur mengikuti SOP

Nilai plus: memiliki ketertarikan pada industri agribisnis/perkebunan atau customer loyalty program

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: AVP-Fixed Voice Product & Service
raw_description:
Job Summary

The AVP-Fixed Voice Product Management is responsible for driving the strategy, development, lifecycle management, and commercialization of fixed voice services (e.g., SIP Trunking, Hosted PBX, PSTN replacement solutions) for enterprise and SME segments. This role ensures the product portfolio is competitive, scalable, and aligned with market demand, revenue targets, and operational efficiency goals.

Job Details

1.Product Lifecycle Management

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of fixed voice products, from launch to retirement.
  • Ensure product relevance through continuous market and customer feedback.
  • Maintain product documentation, feature catalogs, and change logs.

 

2.Operational Excellence

  • Oversee provisioning, activation, and service assurance processes.
  • Monitor SLA compliance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with network and infrastructure teams to ensure deployment readiness.

 

3.Performance & Quality Monitoring

  • Track product performance metrics (revenue achievement, product P&L, etc.)
  • Lead root cause analysis and resolution of recurring service issues.
  • Implement operational dashboards and reporting tools.

 

4.Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with sales, network, IT, and customer service teams.
  • Ensure alignment between product capabilities and delivery processes.
  • Support pre-sales and post-sales teams with product knowledge and operational insights.

 

5.Commercial Support

  • Provide input to pricing and bundling strategies based on operational feasibility.
  • Support GTM execution with operational readiness and service design.
  • Monitor product profitability and cost-to-serve metrics.

 

6.Team Leadership

  • Lead a lean team of product operations specialists and analysts.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, agility, and customer-centricity.
  • Develop team capabilities in lifecycle and operational management.

 

Minimum Requirements:

 

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree from a well-known university in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related STEM field.
  • Master’s degree (MBA or Technology Management) is preferred.
  • Professional certification in voice networking, marketing, or related field is a plus.
  • Recent formal and informal education in Artificial Intelligence and its applications is a plus.

 

Professional Experience:

  • 10-15 years of experience in product management, preferably in fixed voice, connectivity, or telecom solutions (e.g., SIP Trunk, Cloud PBX, LAN, WAN, etc.).
  • Experience in the telecom or ICT industry with exposure to enterprise/B2B markets.
  • Strong background in cross-functional collaboration (technology, sales, delivery, operations).
  • Proven experience leading product lifecycle (development, launch, enhancement, support).
  • Hands-on involvement in product PoC, technical support, and pre-sales activities.

 

Expected Skills

  • Technical & Commercial Understanding with solid grasp of voice network technologies (OSI Layer, fiber optic, SBC, Voice Firewall etc.) and enterprise connectivity solutions.
  • Product Management with ability to define roadmap, manage lifecycle, support sales, and ensure delivery excellence.
  • Analytical Thinking and Reporting with ability to monitor performance, revenue, project pipeline, and churn metrics effectively.

title: Head of Customer Acquisition and Fulfilment
raw_description:
The Head of Customer Acquisition & Fulfillment owns the end-to-end journey of a sold order into an active FTTH service — from customer verification and validation through to installation, activation, and service delivery. This is an AVP-level role leading two functions, Verification & Validation and Service Delivery, and is accountable for ensuring genuine customer acquisition, preventing fraud/recycle-customer cases, and delivering the installation and activation experience promised at the point of sale. Beyond the order itself, the role orchestrates the full onboarding ecosystem — Sales, digital ordering channels, verification, field technicians, and fiber partners — so that acquisition volume grows without compromising quality, and it remains accountable for service quality in the customer's early life after activation. The role plays a critical part in protecting revenue integrity and driving FTTH's targets for interaction volume, First Call Resolution (FCR), and Customer Care CSAT, by ensuring orders are fulfilled right the first time and customers become genuine, satisfied, and retained subscribers.

Scope of Work

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Deliverables

1. Customer Acquisition (Verification & Validation)

-  Lead the Verification & Validation team to confirm FTTH service availability at the customer's location against coverage maps/databases and required infrastructure.

-  Ensure every prospective customer is validated as a genuine customer prior to onboarding, preventing recycle-customer / fraud cases.

-  Set, monitor, and continuously improve verification SLA and accuracy targets; escalate coverage or infrastructure gaps to Technology/Network partners.

Verification & Validation SOP and coverage / infrastructure check workflow

Verification SLA and accuracy performance dashboard

 

Fraud / recycle-customer detection and escalation log.

2. Order Fulfillment & Service Delivery

-  Lead the Service Delivery function across order management, installation scheduling, site preparation, installation/activation, and quality assurance (interim coverage while the dedicated Head of Service Delivery role is vacant).

-  Ensure customer orders progress smoothly from sale through activation, coordinating with Sales, Billing, Technical, and Field Partner teams.

-  Own installation SLA performance, activation turnaround time, and first-time-right installation quality.

Order-to-activation SOP covering scheduling, site prep, installation, and activation;

 

installation SLA and activation turnaround time report;

 

first-time-right installation quality scorecard.

3. End-to-End Order-to-Activation Ownership

-  Act as the single point of accountability for the full journey from sold order to a genuine, verified, and successfully installed/activated service.

-  Build and maintain an integrated reporting cadence covering verification accuracy, installation SLA, activation success rate, and CSAT.

-  Resolve cross-functional bottlenecks between the acquisition (verification) and fulfillment (installation/activation) stages.

integrated acquisition-to-fulfillment performance dashboard (verification accuracy, installation SLA, activation success rate, CSAT)

 

cross-functional bottleneck/issue log with resolution status

 

monthly end-to-end funnel report (sold order → verified → installed → activated).

4. Recycle-Customer Prevention & Verification Integrity

-  Design and own a risk-based verification framework (identity/NIK, address, payment and bad-debt history, prior disconnection and blacklist screening) with clear auto-pass, auto-review, and manual-verification tiers, so recycle and fraudulent customers are blocked before order confirmation while genuine customers stay on a fast, low-friction path.

-  Govern both sides of the trade-off — false-positive rate (genuine customers rejected or delayed) and false-negative rate (recycle customers admitted) — and recalibrate rules, thresholds, and blacklist criteria together with Sales, Finance/Collection, and Fraud Management.

-  Own the authority to reject, hold, or release high-risk orders, and ensure every verification touchpoint follows approved script, channel, and maximum-contact standards so that tightened controls do not increase customer effort, order drop-off, or CSAT loss.

Risk-based verification & anti-recycle policy, including tiering rules, blacklist criteria, and decision authority matrix

 

Recycle/fraud prevention scorecard: recycle-customer rate, detection rate, false-positive rate, and verification turnaround time

 

Verification customer-experience standard with drop-off/CSAT tracking, and monthly rule-calibration review minutes.

5. Sales & Digital Order Journey Collaboration (Cancel-Registration Reduction)

-  Partner with HBB & FWA Sales, HBB Product, and the digital application/web owners to simplify the customer ordering journey — coverage check, registration, document upload, payment, and installation scheduling — reducing steps, rework, and abandonment.

-  Own the analysis of cancelled and abandoned registrations by journey stage, channel, sales agent, and region, and convert the findings into a prioritised change backlog with the application owners.

-  Agree and track joint KPIs with Sales and application owners (order completion rate, cancel-registration rate, order-to-verified cycle time), including agent- and channel-level feedback on mis-sold, incomplete, or out-of-coverage orders.

Order journey funnel analysis (order → registration → payment → verified) with drop-off and cancellation root-cause breakdown

 

Prioritised digital ordering-journey improvement backlog agreed with product/application owners, with before-after impact tracking

 

Joint Sales–Fulfillment KPI dashboard and monthly Sales–Product–Fulfillment review forum minutes with action tracker.

6. End-to-End Onboarding Journey Orchestration

-  Own the design and governance of the end-to-end onboarding journey so that Sales, Verification & Validation, field technicians, fiber partners (AMT, Iforte), Network/Technology, Billing, and the contact center operate as one cohesive chain with clear handover points, SLAs, and RACI.

-  Chair a cross-functional onboarding governance forum to resolve interlock issues (coverage versus sale, port and material availability, technician scheduling, partner capacity) and enforce the quality gates that protect growth: verified feasibility before installation, and completed checklist plus customer confirmation before activation.

-  Model verification, technician, and fiber-partner capacity against the sales forecast, flag capacity risk to Sales and Leadership early, and drive one shared onboarding scorecard so every stakeholder is measured on the same end-to-end outcome.

End-to-end onboarding journey map with RACI, handover SLAs, and quality gates across all internal and partner stakeholders

 

Cross-functional onboarding governance forum: cadence, minutes, escalation matrix, and issue-resolution log

 

Acquisition quality index (gross orders → verified → activated → early cancellation/churn) with capacity-versus-forecast risk flags.

7. Post-Onboarding Service Quality (Early-Life Customer Experience)

-  Own service quality for the first 30/60/90 days after activation — early-life fault rate, repeat trouble tickets, early complaints, and early churn.

-  Run a structured post-installation follow-up and onboarding CSAT/NPS programme, and feed the results back to technicians, fiber partners, and sales channels as accountable quality signals.

-  Analyse early-life complaints by root cause (installation workmanship, ONT/device, network, billing, or expectation gap created at the point of sale), drive upstream corrective action with the accountable owner, and escalate systemic issues to the VP-Head of HBB Operations.

Post-onboarding service quality dashboard (D+7 / D+30 / D+90 fault rate, repeat ticket rate, early churn)

 

Onboarding CSAT/NPS report with driver analysis by technician, fiber partner, and sales channel

 

Early-life root-cause and corrective action log, with a quarterly improvement report to Leadership showing before-after results.

8. People Management

-  Lead and develop the Verification & Validation and Service Delivery teams, setting clear KPIs and measuring performance regularly.

-  Own team structure and tasks, recruitment, performance management, team building, succession planning, mentoring, and training.

-  Provide feedback through 1:1s, personal development plans, and coaching to build a strong pipeline for the future Service Delivery headcount.

team KPI scorecards and performance review records;

 

Succession plan and development plans (PDPs) for Verification & Validation / Service Delivery staff;

 

Training and coaching completion log.

9. Partner Management

-  Manage the performance and SLAs of field/fiber partners (e.g., AMT, Iforte) and the contact center partner (PT VADS) relevant to acquisition and fulfillment.

-  Conduct partner performance reviews and drive corrective action plans for service or quality shortfalls.

Partner Management: partner (AMT, Iforte, Managed Service Contact Center) SLA performance report

 

partner review minutes and corrective action plans (CAPs).

10. Continuous Improvement

-  Ensure the team is continuously trained and capable of maintaining high-quality customer interactions.

-  Identify new tools and technologies to better verify, onboard, and serve customers.

-  Continually develop process improvements and lead change projects across verification and fulfillment workflows, using customer insights and analytics to identify companywide improvements and present these to Leadership.

Process improvement / change project tracker with before-after results;

 

tools & technology adoption roadmap; leadership improvement recommendation deck (from customer insights/analytics).

 

Minimum Requirements

Qualification:

-  Education: A bachelor's degree in business administration, telecommunications, marketing, or a related field; a master's degree or relevant certification is an advantage.

-  Experience: At least 7-8 years' experience in customer operations, verification/fraud prevention, or service delivery/installation, including at least 3 years in a managerial/supervisory role leading multiple teams.

-  Proven track record managing the end-to-end customer lifecycle from acquisition/verification through installation and activation, ideally in telecom/FTTH or broadband services.

-  Leadership Abilities: Strong leadership qualities, including the ability to motivate, coach, and develop teams; experience in performance evaluation and fostering a positive work culture.

-  Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in MS Office, CX/CRM software, ticketing systems, and operational dashboards/analytics tools.

-  Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data, interpret metrics, and draw actionable insights to drive verification accuracy and installation/activation improvements.

-  Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and time management abilities for managing multiple priorities and delegating tasks in a fast-paced environment.

-  Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make independent decisions to resolve subscriber-level and operational issues.

-  Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing circumstances, adopt new technologies, and adjust strategies based on evolving business needs.

-  Customer Focus: Genuine commitment to delivering exceptional customer experience and meeting or exceeding customer expectations.

-  Skilled at working effectively across a matrix organization with Sales, Billing, Technical, and Marketing teams, and managing external field/fiber partners.

Related Experience:

-  Customer Acquisition & Verification Leadership

-  Service Delivery / Installation Operations Management

-  Cross-functional Collaboration

-  Partner & Vendor Management

-  Strategic Planning and Execution

-  Data Analysis and Insights

-  Customer Experience (CX) Focus

-  Industry Knowledge (FTTH / Broadband)

Skills:

-  Leadership

-  Communication

-  Customer Service Expertise

-  Problem-Solving

-  Analytical Thinking

-  Team Management

-  Strategic Planning

-  Time Management

-  Conflict Resolution

The Head of Customer Acquisition & Fulfillment owns the end-to-end journey of a sold order into an active FTTH service — from customer verification and validation through to installation, activation, and service delivery. This is an AVP-level role leading two functions, Verification & Validation and Service Delivery, and is accountable for ensuring genuine customer acquisition, preventing fraud/recycle-customer cases, and delivering the installation and activation experience promised at the point of sale. Beyond the order itself, the role orchestrates the full onboarding ecosystem — Sales, digital ordering channels, verification, field technicians, and fiber partners — so that acquisition volume grows without compromising quality, and it remains accountable for service quality in the customer's early life after activation. The role plays a critical part in protecting revenue integrity and driving FTTH's targets for interaction volume, First Call Resolution (FCR), and Customer Care CSAT, by ensuring orders are fulfilled right the first time and customers become genuine, satisfied, and retained subscribers.

Deliverables

1. Customer Acquisition (Verification & Validation)

-  Lead the Verification & Validation team to confirm FTTH service availability at the customer's location against coverage maps/databases and required infrastructure.

-  Ensure every prospective customer is validated as a genuine customer prior to onboarding, preventing recycle-customer / fraud cases.

-  Set, monitor, and continuously improve verification SLA and accuracy targets; escalate coverage or infrastructure gaps to Technology/Network partners.

Verification & Validation SOP and coverage / infrastructure check workflow

Verification SLA and accuracy performance dashboard

 

Fraud / recycle-customer detection and escalation log.

2. Order Fulfillment & Service Delivery

-  Lead the Service Delivery function across order management, installation scheduling, site preparation, installation/activation, and quality assurance (interim coverage while the dedicated Head of Service Delivery role is vacant).

-  Ensure customer orders progress smoothly from sale through activation, coordinating with Sales, Billing, Technical, and Field Partner teams.

-  Own installation SLA performance, activation turnaround time, and first-time-right installation quality.

Order-to-activation SOP covering scheduling, site prep, installation, and activation;

 

installation SLA and activation turnaround time report;

 

first-time-right installation quality scorecard.

3. End-to-End Order-to-Activation Ownership

-  Act as the single point of accountability for the full journey from sold order to a genuine, verified, and successfully installed/activated service.

-  Build and maintain an integrated reporting cadence covering verification accuracy, installation SLA, activation success rate, and CSAT.

-  Resolve cross-functional bottlenecks between the acquisition (verification) and fulfillment (installation/activation) stages.

integrated acquisition-to-fulfillment performance dashboard (verification accuracy, installation SLA, activation success rate, CSAT)

 

cross-functional bottleneck/issue log with resolution status

 

monthly end-to-end funnel report (sold order → verified → installed → activated).

4. Recycle-Customer Prevention & Verification Integrity

-  Design and own a risk-based verification framework (identity/NIK, address, payment and bad-debt history, prior disconnection and blacklist screening) with clear auto-pass, auto-review, and manual-verification tiers, so recycle and fraudulent customers are blocked before order confirmation while genuine customers stay on a fast, low-friction path.

-  Govern both sides of the trade-off — false-positive rate (genuine customers rejected or delayed) and false-negative rate (recycle customers admitted) — and recalibrate rules, thresholds, and blacklist criteria together with Sales, Finance/Collection, and Fraud Management.

-  Own the authority to reject, hold, or release high-risk orders, and ensure every verification touchpoint follows approved script, channel, and maximum-contact standards so that tightened controls do not increase customer effort, order drop-off, or CSAT loss.

Risk-based verification & anti-recycle policy, including tiering rules, blacklist criteria, and decision authority matrix

 

Recycle/fraud prevention scorecard: recycle-customer rate, detection rate, false-positive rate, and verification turnaround time

 

Verification customer-experience standard with drop-off/CSAT tracking, and monthly rule-calibration review minutes.

5. Sales & Digital Order Journey Collaboration (Cancel-Registration Reduction)

-  Partner with HBB & FWA Sales, HBB Product, and the digital application/web owners to simplify the customer ordering journey — coverage check, registration, document upload, payment, and installation scheduling — reducing steps, rework, and abandonment.

-  Own the analysis of cancelled and abandoned registrations by journey stage, channel, sales agent, and region, and convert the findings into a prioritised change backlog with the application owners.

-  Agree and track joint KPIs with Sales and application owners (order completion rate, cancel-registration rate, order-to-verified cycle time), including agent- and channel-level feedback on mis-sold, incomplete, or out-of-coverage orders.

Order journey funnel analysis (order → registration → payment → verified) with drop-off and cancellation root-cause breakdown

 

Prioritised digital ordering-journey improvement backlog agreed with product/application owners, with before-after impact tracking

 

Joint Sales–Fulfillment KPI dashboard and monthly Sales–Product–Fulfillment review forum minutes with action tracker.

6. End-to-End Onboarding Journey Orchestration

-  Own the design and governance of the end-to-end onboarding journey so that Sales, Verification & Validation, field technicians, fiber partners (AMT, Iforte), Network/Technology, Billing, and the contact center operate as one cohesive chain with clear handover points, SLAs, and RACI.

-  Chair a cross-functional onboarding governance forum to resolve interlock issues (coverage versus sale, port and material availability, technician scheduling, partner capacity) and enforce the quality gates that protect growth: verified feasibility before installation, and completed checklist plus customer confirmation before activation.

-  Model verification, technician, and fiber-partner capacity against the sales forecast, flag capacity risk to Sales and Leadership early, and drive one shared onboarding scorecard so every stakeholder is measured on the same end-to-end outcome.

End-to-end onboarding journey map with RACI, handover SLAs, and quality gates across all internal and partner stakeholders

 

Cross-functional onboarding governance forum: cadence, minutes, escalation matrix, and issue-resolution log

 

Acquisition quality index (gross orders → verified → activated → early cancellation/churn) with capacity-versus-forecast risk flags.

7. Post-Onboarding Service Quality (Early-Life Customer Experience)

-  Own service quality for the first 30/60/90 days after activation — early-life fault rate, repeat trouble tickets, early complaints, and early churn.

-  Run a structured post-installation follow-up and onboarding CSAT/NPS programme, and feed the results back to technicians, fiber partners, and sales channels as accountable quality signals.

-  Analyse early-life complaints by root cause (installation workmanship, ONT/device, network, billing, or expectation gap created at the point of sale), drive upstream corrective action with the accountable owner, and escalate systemic issues to the VP-Head of HBB Operations.

Post-onboarding service quality dashboard (D+7 / D+30 / D+90 fault rate, repeat ticket rate, early churn)

 

Onboarding CSAT/NPS report with driver analysis by technician, fiber partner, and sales channel

 

Early-life root-cause and corrective action log, with a quarterly improvement report to Leadership showing before-after results.

8. People Management

-  Lead and develop the Verification & Validation and Service Delivery teams, setting clear KPIs and measuring performance regularly.

-  Own team structure and tasks, recruitment, performance management, team building, succession planning, mentoring, and training.

-  Provide feedback through 1:1s, personal development plans, and coaching to build a strong pipeline for the future Service Delivery headcount.

team KPI scorecards and performance review records;

 

Succession plan and development plans (PDPs) for Verification & Validation / Service Delivery staff;

 

Training and coaching completion log.

9. Partner Management

-  Manage the performance and SLAs of field/fiber partners (e.g., AMT, Iforte) and the contact center partner (PT VADS) relevant to acquisition and fulfillment.

-  Conduct partner performance reviews and drive corrective action plans for service or quality shortfalls.

Partner Management: partner (AMT, Iforte, Managed Service Contact Center) SLA performance report

 

partner review minutes and corrective action plans (CAPs).

10. Continuous Improvement

-  Ensure the team is continuously trained and capable of maintaining high-quality customer interactions.

-  Identify new tools and technologies to better verify, onboard, and serve customers.

-  Continually develop process improvements and lead change projects across verification and fulfillment workflows, using customer insights and analytics to identify companywide improvements and present these to Leadership.

Process improvement / change project tracker with before-after results;

 

tools & technology adoption roadmap; leadership improvement recommendation deck (from customer insights/analytics).

 

Minimum Requirements

Qualification:

-  Education: A bachelor's degree in business administration, telecommunications, marketing, or a related field; a master's degree or relevant certification is an advantage.

-  Experience: At least 7-8 years' experience in customer operations, verification/fraud prevention, or service delivery/installation, including at least 3 years in a managerial/supervisory role leading multiple teams.

-  Proven track record managing the end-to-end customer lifecycle from acquisition/verification through installation and activation, ideally in telecom/FTTH or broadband services.

-  Leadership Abilities: Strong leadership qualities, including the ability to motivate, coach, and develop teams; experience in performance evaluation and fostering a positive work culture.

-  Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in MS Office, CX/CRM software, ticketing systems, and operational dashboards/analytics tools.

-  Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data, interpret metrics, and draw actionable insights to drive verification accuracy and installation/activation improvements.

-  Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and time management abilities for managing multiple priorities and delegating tasks in a fast-paced environment.

-  Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make independent decisions to resolve subscriber-level and operational issues.

-  Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing circumstances, adopt new technologies, and adjust strategies based on evolving business needs.

-  Customer Focus: Genuine commitment to delivering exceptional customer experience and meeting or exceeding customer expectations.

-  Skilled at working effectively across a matrix organization with Sales, Billing, Technical, and Marketing teams, and managing external field/fiber partners.

-  Customer Acquisition & Verification Leadership

-  Service Delivery / Installation Operations Management

-  Cross-functional Collaboration

-  Strategic Planning and Execution

-  Data Analysis and Insights

-  Customer Experience (CX) Focus

-  Industry Knowledge (FTTH / Broadband)

Skills:
